example: The report offers a blueprint for reform, but critics say it ignores the serious shortage of trained staff. (這份報告提出改革藍圖，但批評者說它忽略了訓練有素人力的嚴重短缺。)

meaning: n. 相互作用 vi. 相互作用
example: The interplay between diet and exercise matters more than any single supplement, according to long-term research on healthy ageing. (根據關於健康老化的長期研究，飲食與運動之間的相互作用比任何單一補充品都重要。)
Online booking is convenient for most passengers, yet older travellers often struggle with the complicated identity verification steps. (線上訂票對多數乘客很方便，但年長旅客常卡在複雜的身分驗證步驟。)
Her genuine interest in local history surprised the curator, who seldom meets visitors willing to stay all afternoon. (她對地方史的真正興趣讓館長很驚訝，因為他很少遇到願意待一整個下午的訪客。)
The staff were unusually attentive throughout the evening, refilling our glasses before we even noticed they were empty. (服務人員整晚格外殷勤，我們還沒發現杯子空了，他們就來添滿。)
Careful observation of the classroom showed that quieter pupils rarely ask for help, even when they are struggling. (仔細觀察教室後發現，較安靜的學生很少求助，即使他們正遇到困難。)
Setting personal goals can improve motivation, but only if the targets remain realistic and are reviewed every few months. (設定個人目標能提升動力，但前提是目標保持務實，且每隔幾個月檢視一次。)
The vitality of the old market returned after the council improved lighting and widened the crowded central passage. (市公所改善照明並拓寬擁擠的中央通道後，老市場的活力又回來了。)
A new medical certificate is now a requirement for every single applicant, which has slowed the process considerably. (新的醫療證明現在是每位申請人的必要條件，這讓流程慢了不少。)
It is advisable to check the equipment before each climb, since small faults can become dangerous at high altitude. (每次攀登前最好檢查裝備，因為小故障在高海拔可能變得危險。)
The company went bankrupt after losing its two biggest customers in a month. (公司在一個月內失去兩個最大客戶後破產。)
Heavy irrigation has seriously depleted the local groundwater, forcing farmers to drill much deeper wells every few years. (大量灌溉已嚴重耗竭當地地下水，迫使農民每隔幾年就鑿更深的井。)

meaning: n. 影響；影響力 vt. 影響
example: The influence of social media on teenage sleep has worried doctors for years, yet parents often underestimate it. (社群媒體對青少年睡眠的影響已讓醫師擔憂多年，但家長往往低估了它。)
She escapes into fantasy whenever the real world feels far too heavy. (現實世界太沉重的時候，她會躲進幻想裡。)
The fire was tragic, but the village rebuilt the hall within two years. (那場火災很悲慘，但村民兩年內就重建了活動中心。)

meaning: n. 夾板 vt. 用夾板固定
example: The vet put a splint on the young dog's broken leg, and it healed within about six weeks. (獸醫在幼犬斷腿上打了夾板，大約六週內就癒合了。)

meaning: n. 泡沫 vi. 起泡沫
example: White foam covered the rocks where the big waves hit the shore. (大浪拍岸處的岩石上覆滿白色泡沫。)
In the form, write your occupation and the name of your employer. (在表格上寫下你的職業和僱主名稱。)

meaning: n. 格式；版式 vt. 格式化
example: The format of the radio programme changed last year, attracting younger listeners while losing some loyal older ones. (這個廣播節目的格式去年改變，吸引了較年輕的聽眾，卻流失一些忠實的老年聽眾。)
He finished his bachelor's degree in 1998 and soon left for Singapore. (他一九九八年拿到學士學位，不久後就前往新加坡。)
The typhoon destroyed most of the banana crop, so prices in the city rose sharply the following week. (颱風摧毀了大部分香蕉作物，因此城市裡的價格隔週大幅上漲。)
She arrived early for her appointment at the bank, but the adviser was still busy with another client. (她提前到銀行赴約，但理專還在忙另一位客戶。)

meaning: n. 斜坡；坡度 vi. 傾斜
example: The old house stands on a gentle slope facing the morning sun. (這棟老房子位在朝晨光的緩坡上。)

meaning: adj. 複雜的 n. 建築群；情結
example: The machine looks complex, yet most faults can be fixed with a simple screwdriver and a little patience. (這台機器看起來很複雜，但多數故障用一把簡單螺絲起子和一點耐心就能修好。)

meaning: adj. 頭頂上的 adv. 在頭頂上 n. 經常開支
example: The overhead fan moved the hot air around, but it brought very little real relief during the afternoon. (頭頂的電風扇攪動著熱空氣，但下午幾乎沒有帶來真正的涼意。)
The town's population is ageing quickly, so the clinic now runs weekly special sessions for people over seventy. (這座小鎮的人口正快速老化，因此診所現在每週為七十歲以上民眾開設特別門診。)

meaning: n. 獵物 vi. 捕食
example: When prey becomes scarce, foxes move closer to nearby villages and often quietly raid household rubbish at night. (獵物變少時，狐狸會靠近附近的村莊，晚上還常悄悄翻找家庭垃圾。)

meaning: n. 目錄 vt. 編目
example: The museum's online catalogue lets researchers search thousands of old photographs without actually visiting the building in person. (博物館的線上目錄讓研究者不必親自到館，就能搜尋數千張老照片。)

meaning: n. 先決條件 adj. 必備的
example: Basic statistics is a prerequisite for this course, so students without it must take an extra class first. (基礎統計是這門課的先決條件，因此沒學過的學生必須先修一門額外的課。)
The teacher's assessment was fair but firm, clearly noting real progress while pointing out two specific weak areas. (老師的評估公正而堅定，清楚指出實際進步，同時點出兩個具體的弱項。)
The doctor suggested walking daily, adding that even twenty brisk minutes would make a noticeable difference to her health. (醫師建議她每天走路，還說即使快走二十分鐘，對健康也會有明顯差別。)
A single volt is enough to light this very tiny glass lamp. (只要一伏特就夠點亮這盞極小的玻璃燈。)
The weeds grew taller than the young corn within just three weeks. (短短三週內，雜草就長得比玉米苗還高。)

meaning: n. 螺絲 v. 用螺絲固定
example: One screw was missing, so the shelf wobbled whenever it was touched. (少了一根螺絲，架子一碰就晃。)
The guide enlightened us about the night habits of the local bats. (導覽員為我們說明本地蝙蝠夜間的習性。)

meaning: n. 紡織品 adj. 紡織的
example: The textile industry consumes enormous amounts of water, which is why recycling old clothes has become genuinely urgent. (紡織業消耗大量水資源，這也是回收舊衣變得真正迫切的原因。)
Do not hesitate to ask for help if the machine jams again. (如果機器又卡住，不要猶豫，直接找人幫忙。)

meaning: n. 導師；家教 v. 指導
example: Her parents hired a private tutor, hoping it would finally help her pass the difficult maths entrance examination. (她父母請了家教，希望這終於能幫她通過艱難的數學入學考試。)
Healthy topsoil contains millions of unseen organisms, yet intensive farming can destroy it within just a few seasons. (健康的表層土含有數百萬看不見的生物，但密集耕作只要幾季就能摧毀它。)
Students from a poorer background often work longer hours, which leaves them less time for study and rest. (出身較貧困的學生往往工作時數更長，這使他們讀書和休息的時間更少。)
Finishing the whole report by Friday is really impossible unless two more colleagues join the small team immediately. (除非立刻再有兩名同事加入這個小團隊，否則週五前完成整份報告根本不可能。)
The only surgeon in the district travels between two hospitals, so emergency operations sometimes wait for long hours. (全區唯一的外科醫師在兩家醫院間奔波，因此緊急手術有時要等上好幾個小時。)

meaning: n. 承諾；預兆 v. 承諾
example: The company broke its promise to protect the forest, and local residents have refused to trust it since. (這家公司違背保護森林的承諾，當地居民從此拒絕再信任它。)
The battery in the torch died halfway through the long power cut. (停電停到一半，手電筒的電池就沒電了。)

meaning: n. 雷；雷聲 v. 打雷
example: Thunder rolled across the valley, and the dog hid under the bed. (雷聲在山谷間滾動，狗躲到床底下。)

meaning: adj. 精緻的；微妙的；脆弱的
example: The box was decorated with delicate patterns cut from very thin paper. (盒子上裝飾著用極薄紙張剪出的精緻圖案。)

meaning: n. 帳戶；敘述 v. 解釋；佔（比例）
example: Her account of the long journey was vivid, describing the dust, the heat and the kindness of strangers. (她對這趟漫長旅程的敘述很生動，描述了塵土、酷熱和陌生人的善意。)
The booklet explains how to sort rubbish for collection in this area. (這本小冊子說明這個地區如何分類垃圾以利清運。)
The layout of the market makes it easy to walk between the stalls. (市場的佈局讓人很容易在攤位之間走動。)

meaning: n. 風險投資；冒險 v. 冒險
example: The farm shop began as a small venture run by two sisters. (這家農場商店原本是兩姊妹經營的小型創業投資。)
The library's budget has unfortunately shrunk again, so several popular magazines will no longer be available next year. (圖書館的預算不幸又縮減了，因此幾本受歡迎的雜誌明年將不再提供。)
The doctor checked the glands in his neck and asked about fever. (醫師檢查他脖子上的腺體，並詢問有沒有發燒。)
The school added farming to the curriculum so pupils could learn practical skills. (學校把農務納入課程，讓學生能學到實用技能。)
A serious water shortage during the hot summer forced the city to restrict garden watering and close several public fountains. (炎熱夏季的嚴重缺水迫使市政府限制澆灌花園，並關閉幾座公共噴泉。)
The hospital's accreditation depends on regular inspections, so staff spend weeks carefully preparing documents before every single visit. (醫院的認證取決於定期稽查，因此員工在每次稽查前都花好幾週仔細準備文件。)
The clerk at the counter found our booking under the wrong name. (櫃檯職員用錯誤的名字找到我們的訂位。)
Please attach a photograph to the form and sign at the bottom. (請在表格上附一張照片，並在下方簽名。)

meaning: v. 輕拋；翻轉 n. 翻轉
example: He flipped the pancake too early and it landed on the floor. (他太早翻煎餅，結果掉到地上。)

meaning: n. 評論；意見 v. 評論
example: One careless comment posted online can quickly damage a reputation, even when the writer later apologises in public. (網路上張貼的一句輕率評論能迅速損害名聲，即使發文者後來公開道歉也一樣。)
The instructor emphasized the need to check the rope twice before climbing. (教練強調攀爬前一定要檢查繩索兩次。)

meaning: n. 火焰；熱情 v. 燃燒
example: The candle flame flickered whenever the door opened, so we moved the old table away from the draught. (每次門一開，燭火就搖曳不定，所以我們把舊桌子移離風口。)
Nobody could foresee that the small roadside café would become so popular. (沒有人預見這家路邊小店會變得這麼受歡迎。)
The two countries finally signed a historic agreement on water sharing, ending a dispute that lasted many decades. (兩國終於簽署了共享水資源的歷史性協議，結束長達數十年的爭端。)
The provision of affordable childcare allows more parents to return to work, especially in areas with long waiting lists. (提供平價托育讓更多父母能重返職場，尤其是在等候名單很長的地區。)
The club president resigned unexpectedly after the dispute, leaving the committee to choose a temporary replacement before June. (爭議過後，社長意外辭職，留下委員會得在六月前選出臨時接任者。)
The internist listened carefully to the symptoms before ordering blood tests, which later revealed a mild thyroid problem. (內科醫師仔細聆聽症狀後才安排驗血，結果後來發現輕微的甲狀腺問題。)
Radio reception is clearer at night, so many drivers often listen to their favourite stations during long journeys. (夜間廣播收訊較清楚，因此許多駕駛在長途旅程中常收聽自己喜歡的電台。)
The league suspended the player for two matches, although many fans felt the punishment was far too harsh. (聯盟將這名球員禁賽兩場，儘管許多球迷覺得懲罰太重了。)
The explorer spent months in the deep cave, carefully recording temperatures and collecting samples that later surprised geologists. (這位探險家在深洞裡待了幾個月，仔細記錄溫度並採集後來讓地質學家驚訝的樣本。)
That website looks professional but is completely untrustworthy, since several experts have widely exposed its invented health statistics. (那個網站看起來很專業，卻完全不可靠，因為幾位專家已廣泛揭穿它捏造的健康統計。)
Prospective buyers were shown around the flat on a rainy Tuesday evening. (潛在買家在一個下雨的週二晚上參觀了這間公寓。)
A growing percentage of graduates now work in jobs unrelated to their degree, according to a recent national survey. (根據最近一項全國調查，現在有越來越高比例的畢業生從事與所學無關的工作。)
The muddy footprints on the path gave the police their first real clue. (小路上的泥腳印給了警方第一個真正的線索。)

meaning: v. 口吃 n. 口吃
example: The boy began to stammer whenever he was asked to read aloud, so his teacher offered private practice. (這男孩每次被要求朗讀就開始結巴，因此老師提供私下練習的機會。)
A hawk circled above the field, watching for mice in the grass. (一隻鷹在田野上空盤旋，留意草裡的老鼠。)

meaning: n. 沼澤 vt. 淹沒；使應接不暇
example: The swamp behind the farm is full of frogs and biting mosquitoes. (農場後面的沼澤滿是青蛙和咬人的蚊子。)
He was jealous of his brother, who had won a place at art school. (他很嫉妒弟弟，因為弟弟考上了藝術學校。)

meaning: n. 幫忙；恩惠 vt. 偏愛；贊同
example: Could you do me a favour and post this letter on your way? (能不能幫個忙，順路幫我寄這封信？)
Public taste is fickle, so restaurants that follow every sudden fashion often struggle to keep loyal long-term customers. (大眾口味善變，因此追逐每一股突然流行風潮的餐廳，往往難以留住忠實的長期顧客。)

meaning: adv. 上坡；艱難地 adj. 上坡的
example: We walked uphill for an hour before the path finally flattened out. (我們上坡走了一小時，路才終於變平。)
She succeeded in persuading the shop to take back the broken chair. (她成功說服店家收回那張壞掉的椅子。)
The report found a clear gender pay gap, although the company insists that its hiring process is fair. (報告發現明顯的性別薪資差距，儘管公司堅稱其招聘流程公平。)
The team unexpectedly won five consecutive matches, which suddenly lifted them from the bottom of the whole division. (這支球隊意外連贏五場，突然把他們從整個分區的墊底位置拉了上來。)
A last-minute diversion sent pedestrians along the river, adding ten minutes to their usual walk to the station. (臨時改道讓行人沿著河邊走，使他們平常到車站的路多花十分鐘。)
Students organised a blood drive and persuaded dozens of classmates to donate generously, exceeding the hospital's original target. (學生籌辦捐血活動，說服數十位同學慷慨捐血，超出醫院原本的目標。)
Good passwords are the first defence against online theft, yet many people still reuse the same one everywhere. (良好的密碼是防範網路竊盜的第一道防線，但許多人仍在各處重複使用同一組密碼。)
The volume of traffic through the village has doubled, making the narrow main street increasingly dangerous for cyclists. (穿越村莊的車流量已經加倍，讓狹窄的主要街道對自行車族越來越危險。)

meaning: n. 退款 vt. 退還
example: The shop gave her a full refund when the kettle stopped working. (水壺壞掉後，店家全額退款給她。)
The old bridge will be repaired regardless of cost, because the nearest alternative route is forty miles away. (這座老橋將不計成本修復，因為最近的替代路線在四十英里外。)
The invitation was embossed with a pattern of small silver autumn leaves. (邀請卡上壓印著小銀色秋葉的圖案。)

meaning: n. 國際主義者 adj. 國際主義的
example: As an internationalist, she believes students should study abroad, even if that means learning a difficult second language. (身為國際主義者，她認為學生應該出國留學，即使那意味著要學一門困難的第二外語。)
The wind scattered the dry leaves across the courtyard and into the hall. (風把乾葉子吹散到庭院各處，還吹進了大廳。)
The long walk gave the children a huge appetite for their dinner. (走這麼長的路，讓孩子們晚餐時食慾大開。)
This old belief still prevails in the villages far from the coast. (這個古老的觀念在遠離海岸的村落仍然盛行。)
The online glossary explains every confusing technical term, so readers no longer need to search elsewhere while studying. (這份線上詞彙表解釋每個令人困惑的專業術語，讀者讀書時不必再到別處查詢。)
The consolidation of three departments reduced costs, but it also weakened the close teamwork that staff once valued. (三個部門合併後降低了成本，卻也削弱了員工曾經珍視的緊密團隊合作。)
Sulphuric acid must be stored in a labelled container away from water. (硫酸必須存放在有標示的容器裡，遠離水源。)
A small act of goodwill between neighbours can easily prevent bitter arguments that would otherwise last for years. (鄰居間一個小小的善意舉動，就能輕鬆避免原本可能持續多年的激烈爭吵。)
Over thirty years he amassed a remarkably large collection of old maps. (三十年間他積聚了一批數量可觀的舊地圖。)
Federal funding paid for the new road, but the town maintains it. (新路是用聯邦經費蓋的，但由鎮公所維護。)
Safety should be the main consideration when choosing a school, not merely the reputation of its expensive buildings. (選擇學校時，安全應是主要考量，而不只是它昂貴建築的名聲。)

meaning: v. 緊握；抓住 n. 緊握；掌握
example: He gripped the rail tightly as the boat rocked in the wind. (船在風中搖晃時，他緊緊握住欄杆。)
The old stone mansion was turned into a hotel with twelve rooms. (這棟老石造豪宅被改成有十二個房間的旅館。)
Our galaxy contains billions of stars, many of them with their own planets. (我們的星系有數十億顆恆星，其中許多都有自己的行星。)
The walking route crosses two open fields and a small wood, so good sturdy shoes are strongly recommended. (這條健行路線穿過兩片開闊田野和一座小樹林，因此強烈建議穿堅固的好鞋。)
A deficiency of iron in the soil makes the leaves turn yellow. (土壤缺乏鐵質會讓葉子變黃。)

meaning: prep. 在……對面 adj. 相反的；對面的 n. 對立面
example: The hotel stands opposite the main station, which makes it very convenient for travellers arriving late at night. (這家飯店位於主要車站對面，對深夜抵達的旅客來說非常方便。)
The newspaper deliberately printed a sensational headline, although the actual story contained very little new and accurate information. (報紙刻意印出聳動的標題，儘管實際報導幾乎沒有新的、準確的資訊。)
Participation in team sports teaches children important lessons about cooperation, yet many schools have cut physical education to save money. (參與團隊運動教孩子合作的重要課題，但許多學校為省錢而刪減體育課。)
To her great relief, the missing keys were in her coat pocket. (令她十分欣慰的是，不見的鑰匙就在外套口袋裡。)
The cultivation of rice requires huge amounts of water, which is why farmers here built terraces centuries ago. (種稻需要大量水，這就是這裡的農民幾百年前就築起梯田的原因。)
The building has no pretension, offering simple honest rooms that stay cool in summer and warm in winter. (這棟建築毫不自命不凡，提供簡單樸實的房間，夏天涼爽、冬天溫暖。)

meaning: vt. 利用；控制 n. 馬具
example: Engineers hope to harness tidal energy along this coast, although the equipment must survive extremely rough winter seas. (工程師希望利用這段海岸的潮汐能，儘管設備必須挺過極度洶湧的冬季海象。)

meaning: adj. 彎曲的 n. 愛好；天賦
example: The bicycle wheel was badly bent after the accident, so the repair shop replaced it instead of straightening it. (腳踏車輪框在事故後嚴重彎曲，因此修車店直接換新，而不是把它矯正。)
The workers' dormitory is clean but crowded, with six people sharing one small room and a single bathroom. (工人宿舍乾淨但擁擠，六個人共用一個小房間和一間浴室。)
The nurse stitched the cut quickly and neatly, then told him to keep the bandage dry for three days. (護理師迅速而整齊地縫合傷口，接著囑咐他三天內保持繃帶乾燥。)

meaning: n. 手冊 adj. 手工的
example: The camera manual is badly translated, so many frustrated owners now simply search online for clearer step-by-step instructions. (相機手冊翻譯得很糟，因此許多受挫的機主現在乾脆上網找更清楚的逐步說明。)
This common tiny mite damages tomato leaves, yet it is almost invisible until the plants begin to yellow. (這種常見的微小蟎蟲會傷害番茄葉，但牠幾乎看不見，直到植株開始變黃。)
A burglar entered through the kitchen window while the whole family slept. (竊賊趁全家熟睡時從廚房窗戶潛入。)

meaning: n. 計劃；方案；陰謀 v. 謀劃
example: The scheme to plant trees along the road was delayed by funding cuts. (沿路種樹的計畫因為經費削減而延後。)
The new addition to the school provides four bright classrooms, although the playground has unfortunately become noticeably smaller. (學校的新增建部分提供四間明亮的教室，不過操場不幸明顯變小了。)
Older adults may experience gradual sensory loss, which makes crowded places confusing and can lead to social isolation. (年長者可能經歷逐漸的感官退化，這讓擁擠場所令人困惑，還可能導致社交孤立。)
A small quiet grove of olive trees hides the chapel, where villagers still gather for weddings in summer. (一小片安靜的橄欖樹叢遮住禮拜堂，村民夏天仍會在那裡聚辦婚禮。)

meaning: adj. 物質主義的；唯物主義的
example: Critics say advertising constantly makes children materialistic, although parents can counter this by discussing needs and wants openly. (批評者說廣告不斷讓孩子變得物質主義，不過父母可以公開討論「需要」與「想要」來抗衡。)
You can detach the hood from the jacket and wear it alone. (你可以把帽兜從外套上拆下來單獨戴。)
A torrent of water rushed down the street after the pipe burst. (水管爆裂後，一股洪流沿著街道沖下來。)
Could you clarify what you mean by a fair share of the water? (能不能請你說明，所謂公平分水是什麼意思？)
The runners were very thirsty after an hour in the midday heat. (跑者在正午高溫下跑了一小時後非常口渴。)
Officers inspect the kitchens of all the local restaurants twice every year. (稽查人員每年檢查所有本地餐廳的廚房兩次。)
Water came through a seam in the roof during the heavy storm. (暴風雨時，雨水從屋頂的接縫滲進來。)
Agriculture uses most of the water in this dry and dusty river valley. (這個乾燥多沙的河谷，大部分用水都用在農業上。)
The school is a small microcosm of society, where friendships and conflicts form every day with surprising speed. (學校是社會的小縮影，友誼與衝突每天都在其中以驚人的速度形成。)
She needs surgery on her shoulder and will be off work for a month. (她的肩膀需要動手術，將有一個月不能上班。)
The flood was a catastrophe for farmers who had just planted their crops. (對剛播種的農民來說，這場水災是大災難。)

meaning: v. 過度工作 n. 過度勞累
example: His illness was caused by years of overwork and far too little sleep. (他的病是長年過度勞累和睡眠嚴重不足造成的。)
Parental consent is needed before the children can join the school trip. (孩子參加學校旅行前需要家長同意。)
A thick layer of brown sediment covered the riverbed after the landslide. (山崩之後，河床覆上一層厚厚的褐色沉積物。)

meaning: adj. 各種各樣的；不同的
example: People volunteer for various reasons, from gaining new experience to simply meeting local neighbours in a friendly setting. (人們當志工的理由各種各樣，從獲得新經驗到單純在友善的環境中認識鄰居都有。)

meaning: v. 補考；重修 n. 補考
example: The university charges a small fee for each resit, which many students consider unfair and quietly resent having to pay. (大學對每次補考收取小額費用，許多學生認為不公平，也對必須付錢暗自不滿。)

meaning: n. 威脅 vt. 威脅
example: Plastic waste has become a serious menace to sea life, yet production continues to rise every single year. (塑膠垃圾已成為海洋生物的嚴重威脅，但產量仍逐年上升。)
Many packaged snacks contain hidden salt and sugar, so shoppers should carefully read the labels before buying anything. (許多包裝零食含有隱藏的鹽和糖，因此購物者買任何東西前都應仔細閱讀標示。)
Please always fasten the gate behind you, because the sheep can wander onto the nearby road very easily. (請務必隨手把門扣好，因為羊很容易晃到附近的馬路上。)
They established a small local charity to repair bicycles, giving unused bikes to students who cannot afford transport. (他們成立了一個小型地方慈善組織來修理腳踏車，把閒置的車送給付不起交通費的學生。)

meaning: n. 位置；職位；立場 vt. 安置
example: Her overall position in the race improved steadily, although she never quite caught the two leaders ahead of her. (她在比賽中的總排名穩定進步，儘管始終沒能追上領先的兩名選手。)
The computer program simulates the flow of water through the new pipes. (這個電腦程式模擬水流經過新管線的情況。)

meaning: v. 抓；刮傷 n. 刮痕
example: Try not to scratch the bite, since broken skin can quickly become infected during very hot, humid weather. (盡量不要抓被咬的地方，因為在非常炎熱潮溼的天氣裡，破皮很快就會感染。)
Flexitime helps parents manage daily school runs, yet some managers worry that it weakens teamwork across different departments. (彈性工時幫助父母應付每天的接送，但有些主管擔心它會削弱跨部門的團隊合作。)
Neighbours assist the elderly couple with weekly shopping, which allows them to remain safely in their own home. (鄰居協助這對老夫婦每週採買，讓他們能安全地留在自己家中。)
The blue whale is the largest mammal on Earth, yet it feeds almost entirely on tiny shrimp-like creatures. (藍鯨是地球上最大的哺乳動物，卻幾乎完全以微小的蝦類生物為食。)
Downloading films illegally is common, but the practice still damages smaller studios that cannot absorb the sudden losses. (非法下載電影很普遍，但這種行為仍傷害承受不起突發損失的小型片廠。)
The two plans differ, but they ultimately aim at the same thing. (這兩個方案不同，但最終目標是一樣的。)
The old horse's sinews were stiff, so the vet advised gentle daily exercise rather than standing still all day. (老馬的肌腱僵硬，因此獸醫建議每天溫和運動，而不是整天站著不動。)
This juice contains no artificial colour, yet it still tastes surprisingly sweet for a product with no added sugar. (這款果汁不含人工色素，但對未加糖的產品來說，喝起來仍甜得令人意外。)

meaning: n. 面紗；遮蔽物 vt. 掩飾
example: A veil of secrecy surrounds the negotiations, so reporters have been patiently waiting outside the building since morning. (這場談判籠罩著一層神秘面紗，因此記者從早上就在大樓外耐心等候。)
People tend to overestimate how quickly they can finish a task, which causes unnecessary stress and missed deadlines. (人們往往高估自己完成任務的速度，這造成不必要的壓力和錯過的期限。)
The removal of the old dam let the fish return to the river. (舊水壩拆除後，魚群得以回到河中。)

meaning: adj. 平行的；類似的 n. 相似之處；緯線 vt. 與……相似
example: A parallel path runs beside the busy main road, safe for bicycles. (繁忙的主要道路旁有一條平行的步道，騎腳踏車很安全。)
New rules compel companies to publish their annual emissions, though smaller firms complain about the rising administrative burden. (新規定強制企業公布年度排放量，不過較小的公司抱怨行政負擔日益加重。)
The ambulance arrived immediately after the emergency call, and the crew began treatment before carefully moving the patient. (緊急電話後救護車立刻抵達，救護人員先開始治療，才小心移動病人。)

meaning: n. 研究所；學院 vt. 設立
example: The institute publishes a detailed report on coastal erosion every two years. (這個研究所每兩年發表一份詳細的海岸侵蝕報告。)

meaning: n. 連續劇 adj. 連續的
example: The radio serial ran for six weeks and ended with a storm. (這齣廣播連續劇播了六週，以一場暴風雨收尾。)
A senior officer will oversee the whole project, ensuring that spending stays strictly within the original agreed budget. (一位資深主管將監督整個專案，確保支出嚴格控制在原先議定的預算內。)
Steel bars were added to reinforce the walls of the old school. (工人加上鋼筋，以加強老學校的牆壁。)
Her commitment to the youth club kept it running for a decade. (她對青少年俱樂部的投入，讓它持續運作了十年。)
A donation of five hundred books filled the shelves of the new library. (五百本書的捐贈，讓新圖書館的書架都擺滿了。)
The little girl was curious about the new neighbour, so she quietly asked her mother a stream of endless questions. (小女孩對新鄰居很好奇，因此悄悄問了母親一連串問不完的問題。)
The narrow path into the jungle is muddy and easy to lose. (進入叢林的窄路泥濘，很容易迷路。)
The bank charges high interest on an overdraft, so he tried to repay it before the end of the month. (銀行對透支收取高額利息，因此他試著在月底前還清。)
The optical illusion makes the narrow corridor look genuinely longer, which confuses first-time visitors almost every single day. (這個光學錯覺讓窄走廊看起來真的更長，幾乎每天都讓初次來訪的人搞不清楚。)

meaning: adv. 否則；在其他方面 conj. 否則
example: We must leave by six, otherwise the heavy traffic will certainly make us late for the opening ceremony. (我們必須六點前出發，否則繁忙的交通一定會讓我們趕不上開幕典禮。)
The monk owns very few material possessions, yet he insists that his life feels genuinely richer than most. (這位僧人擁有的物質財物極少，卻堅稱自己的生活比大多數人真正富足。)

meaning: adv. 然而；無論如何 conj. 然而
example: The second-hand van was cheap; however, it unfortunately broke down twice during the very first long journey north. (這輛二手廂型車很便宜；然而，它在第一次北上長途旅程中就不幸拋錨兩次。)

meaning: n. 零售 v. 零售
example: Retail jobs often involve long evening hours, yet they provide much-needed flexible work for local students and parents. (零售工作常需長時間上晚班，卻為當地學生和父母提供亟需的彈性工作。)
Cultural differences can cause small misunderstandings at work, so training sessions help new staff settle into the team quickly. (文化差異可能在工作上造成小誤會，因此培訓課程能幫新員工快速融入團隊。)
The morality of using artificial intelligence in courts deserves careful public debate, not a hasty decision by officials. (在法庭使用人工智慧的道德問題值得公開仔細辯論，而不是官員倉促決定。)
Every online transaction leaves a permanent record, which makes fraud easier to trace but also seriously threatens privacy. (每筆線上交易都留下永久紀錄，這讓詐騙更容易追查，卻也嚴重威脅隱私。)

meaning: adj. 雙重的；兩倍的 adv. 兩倍地
example: The study found a twofold increase in allergies, though the reasons remain unclear and require further careful research. (研究發現過敏案例增加為兩倍，不過原因仍不清楚，需要進一步仔細研究。)
Engineers proposed a simple long-term solution to the noise problem, but many residents doubt it will actually work. (工程師對噪音問題提出簡單的長期解決辦法，但許多居民懷疑它真能奏效。)
The embassy closed early because of the protest, leaving dozens of visa applicants waiting outside in the rain. (大使館因抗議而提前關閉，讓數十名簽證申請人在雨中苦等。)

meaning: v. 評論；察覺 n. 評論
example: A guest quietly remarked that the soup needed more salt, which unfortunately embarrassed the rather young cook slightly. (一位客人輕聲說湯需要多點鹽，這不幸讓相當年輕的廚師有點尷尬。)
The long delay at the airport ruined our plans, so we missed the family dinner and arrived home after midnight. (機場的長時間延誤打亂了我們的計畫，因此錯過家庭聚餐，午夜過後才到家。)
The international medical congress attracted thousands of doctors, who filled every single hotel room in the small city. (這場國際醫學大會吸引數千名醫師，把這座小城的每間飯店都住滿了。)
Washing your hands well removes most of the germs that cause stomach illness. (好好洗手可以去除大部分引起腸胃疾病的細菌。)
She neatly folded the clean sheets in a careful fashion, making sure every single corner was perfectly straight. (她把乾淨的床單整齊地以細心的方式摺好，確保每個角都完美平整。)

meaning: n. 行李轉盤；旋轉木馬
example: The baggage carousel simply stopped working, so hundreds of tired passengers waited while staff carried bags by hand. (行李轉盤就這樣停止運作，數百名疲累的旅客只能等著工作人員徒手搬行李。)
She splashed cold water on her face to stay awake while driving. (她開車時把冷水潑在臉上，讓自己保持清醒。)
You should book the tickets beforehand, because the show always sells out. (你應該事先訂票，因為表演總是會賣完。)
He dug the hole with a spade and filled it with compost. (他用鏟子挖洞，再填進堆肥。)

meaning: n. 過濾器 v. 過濾
example: The water filter removes most impurities, yet unfortunately it cannot improve the strange taste of the old pipes. (這台濾水器能去除大部分雜質，但可惜無法改善老舊水管造成的怪味。)
The financial aspect worries her most, since the treatment is expensive and insurance covers only part of it. (財務方面最讓她擔心，因為這項治療昂貴，而保險只負擔一部分。)
The neighbours raised an objection to the plan for a new car park. (鄰居對新停車場的計畫提出反對。)

meaning: n. 隧道 v. 挖隧道
example: A narrow tunnel beneath the motorway lets wildlife cross safely, reducing the number of animals killed each year. (高速公路下方的窄隧道讓野生動物安全穿越，減少每年被撞死的動物數量。)

meaning: n. 對比；差異 v. 對比
example: The contrast between the two gardens is striking in the early spring. (早春時，這兩座花園的對比非常明顯。)

meaning: n. 影響；效果 vt. 實現
example: The medicine controls the pain effectively, but unfortunately its main side effect is persistent tiredness during the day. (這種藥能有效控制疼痛，但可惜主要副作用是白天持續疲倦。)
A parcel arrived for you this morning, but it needs a signature. (早上有人送來你的包裹，但要簽名。)
From this distance, the two towers look almost exactly the same height. (從這個距離看，兩座塔的高度幾乎完全一樣。)

meaning: n. 莖；詞幹 vt. 阻止 vi. 源自
example: The vine's thick stem climbs the wall, and its leaves shade the entire kitchen window throughout the long summer. (藤蔓粗厚的莖爬上牆，葉子整個漫長的夏天都遮住整扇廚房窗戶。)
Returning to normal working hours helped him sleep better, although he still felt tired for the first week. (恢復正常工作時間後他睡得比較好，儘管第一週仍覺得疲倦。)
Her apology sounded sincere, so he agreed to forget the whole argument. (她的道歉聽起來很真誠，所以他同意不再計較那場爭執。)
Please summarise the main points on a single page before the meeting. (開會前請把重點總結在一頁紙上。)
Good teachers learn from their students, and vice versa, which makes the classroom feel more like a conversation. (好老師會向學生學習，反之亦然，這讓教室更像一場對話。)
By the sixth month, the foetus can hear sounds, so parents often talk or sing to the bump. (到了第六個月，胎兒就能聽見聲音，因此父母常對著肚子說話或唱歌。)
The two village schools merged last year because pupil numbers had fallen. (兩所村校去年合併，因為學生人數減少了。)
Many drivers are not aware that idling engines waste fuel, so simple roadside signs could change their habits. (許多駕駛不知道怠速空轉會浪費燃油，因此簡單的路邊標示就能改變他們的習慣。)

meaning: vt. 貼標籤於 n. 標籤；標記；稱號
example: Parents must clearly label each and every single item of clothing before their young children leave for summer camp. (年幼的孩子去夏令營前，父母必須清楚標示每一件衣物。)

meaning: v. 保證；允諾 n. 保證；擔保物
example: The restaurant cannot guarantee a quiet table by the window, but it will call if one becomes free. (餐廳無法保證有靠窗的安靜桌位，但一有空位就會打電話通知。)

meaning: n. 相互關聯；相互影響
example: The interrelationship between climate and farming is very complex, which makes long-term planning difficult for small remote villages. (氣候與農業之間的相互關聯非常複雜，這讓偏遠小村莊難以做長期規劃。)
The office ordered fresh stationery, including envelopes, pens and a new stapler. (辦公室訂了新的文具，包括信封、筆和一個釘書機。)
The old church was built from soft local limestone, which has slowly darkened over several centuries of weather. (這座老教堂用當地柔軟的石灰岩建成，幾世紀的風吹雨打讓它慢慢變黑。)
On an impulse, she bought a ticket and joined the trip south. (一時衝動，她買了票就跟着南下旅行。)

meaning: n. 蠟；蜂蠟 v. 打蠟；漸圓
example: A thin layer of wax protects the wooden table from spilled water. (薄薄一層蠟可以保護木桌不被打翻的水滲壞。)
The snowstorm completely incapacitated the major railway network, leaving thousands of commuters stranded at busy city stations overnight. (暴風雪讓主要鐵路網完全癱瘓，數千名通勤族整夜受困在繁忙的市區車站。)
A tall stranger appears in the background of the old photograph, although nobody remembers seeing him that day. (這張老照片的背景裡出現一位高個子陌生人，但沒有人記得那天見過他。)

meaning: v. 檢查；阻止 n. 檢查；帳單
example: Always check the bill carefully, because some restaurants sometimes add extra items that nobody at the table ordered. (一定要仔細檢查帳單，因為有些餐廳有時會多列桌上沒有人點的東西。)
Volunteers collected signatures outside the busy market, hoping to force a public vote on the planned car park. (志工在繁忙的市場外收集簽名，希望迫使當局就計畫中的停車場舉行公投。)
The festival attracts thousands of visitors, which helps local shops but also strains the narrow quiet country roads. (這個節慶吸引數千名遊客，帶動當地商店，卻也讓狹窄安靜的鄉間道路不堪負荷。)
It is simply hard to describe the relief we felt when the missing old dog finally came home. (當走失的老狗終於回家時，我們那種如釋重負的感覺真的很難描述。)

meaning: n. 大塊；相當大的部分（或數量）
example: A large chunk of the cliff fell into the sea during the storm. (暴風雨時，一大塊峭壁崩落海中。)
The travel agency arranged everything, from flights to insurance, yet it actually forgot to confirm the hotel booking. (旅行社安排好一切，從機票到保險，卻竟然忘了確認飯店訂房。)

meaning: v. （使）混合 n. 混合物；混合
example: This tea blends three local mountain herbs, giving it a pleasant scent that most visitors find surprisingly familiar. (這款茶混合三種本地山草藥，散發出多數訪客覺得似曾相識的宜人香氣。)
The park was conceived as a place where old and young could meet. (這座公園最初的構想，是讓老少都能相聚的地方。)
Noise from the nearby airport affects residents' sleep, especially for those living closest to the busy flight path. (附近機場的噪音影響居民的睡眠，尤其是住得最靠近繁忙航道的人。)
Repeated delays frustrated the tired passengers waiting on the cold, windy platform. (一再延誤，讓在又冷又颳風的月台上等候的疲累乘客很挫折。)
She applied to extend her student visa, but the office officially warned that processing could take several weeks. (她申請延長學生簽證，但辦事處正式警告處理可能需要好幾週。)
The council introduced a new fee for household garden waste, which sharply reduced illegal dumping within just a few weeks. (市公所對家庭庭園廢棄物收取新費用，短短幾週內就大幅減少非法傾倒。)
Her advice on saving money each month was practical, although it required far more discipline than he had expected. (她關於每月存錢的建議很實際，儘管這需要比他預期更多的自律。)
His attitude to risk changed entirely after the accident, and he now avoids driving alone on dark nights. (事故後他對風險的態度完全改變，現在他避免在黑夜獨自開車。)

meaning: v. 交付；遞送；發表；接生
example: She delivered her short speech without notes, which impressed the entire audience and quietly silenced the earlier criticism. (她沒看稿就發表了簡短演說，讓全場觀眾印象深刻，也悄悄平息了先前的批評。)

meaning: n. 課程；過程；路線 v. 流動
example: The practical first-aid course lasts one weekend, yet it covers bleeding, burns and basic emergency resuscitation quite thoroughly. (這門實用急救課只上一個週末，卻相當徹底地涵蓋止血、燒傷和基本緊急心肺復甦。)

meaning: n. 火柴；比賽；對手 v. 匹配
example: The match was abandoned after sudden heavy rain, so disappointed fans received a full refund for their tickets. (比賽因突然的大雨取消，失望的球迷獲得全額退票。)
Researchers employ simple short surveys to measure happiness, although critics question whether such numbers really mean much at all. (研究者用簡單的短問卷衡量幸福感，不過批評者質疑這類數字究竟有多大意義。)

meaning: n. 踏板 v. 踩踏板；騎車
example: One pedal on the old bicycle was loose and made a noise. (這輛舊腳踏車的一個踏板鬆了，會發出聲音。)

meaning: n. 居民；住戶 adj. 居住的；常駐的
example: Local residents complained that the new street lights were far too bright. (居民抱怨新路燈實在太亮了。)
The optometrist found that his left eye had become slightly worse again. (驗光師發現他的左眼度數又稍微變差了。)

meaning: v. 降級；墮落；退化；降解
example: Plastic bags degrade very slowly and remain in the soil for years. (塑膠袋降解得很慢，會在土壤裡留好幾年。)
Tiny particles of dust in the air make the sunset look red. (空氣中的細微塵粒讓夕陽看起來偏紅。)
A sudden downpour flooded the busy underground station, forcing commuters to wait outside until the water slowly drained. (突然的暴雨淹沒繁忙的地下車站，通勤族被迫在外等候，直到積水慢慢退去。)
The observatory's new telescope is so powerful that it can clearly detect faint planets orbiting even distant stars. (天文台的新望遠鏡威力強大，能清楚偵測到環繞遙遠恆星的微弱行星。)

meaning: n. 運輸；運輸系統 vt. 運輸；搬運
example: Public transport in the valley is limited to two buses a day. (這個山谷的大眾運輸一天只有兩班公車。)
She prepared for the exam by testing herself daily, which reduced much of her anxiety before the final week. (她每天自我測驗來準備考試，這在最後一週前消除了她大半的焦慮。)
Registration at the new clinic usually opens at eight, and patients without an appointment must wait patiently outside. (新診所的掛號通常八點開始，沒有預約的病人必須在外面耐心等候。)
The concert ended in chaos when the power failed, and thousands of fans tried to leave at once. (停電時演唱會陷入混亂，數千名歌迷同時想離場。)

meaning: n. 峽谷 v. 狼吞虎嚥
example: The bridge crosses a narrow deep gorge, offering walkers a view that few other routes can truly match. (這座橋橫跨狹窄深谷，提供健行者少有其他路線能真正比擬的視野。)
Recreational cycling has grown very quickly, so the council is building safer paths away from the busy main roads. (休閒自行車運動成長非常快，因此市公所正在遠離繁忙幹道處興建更安全的路線。)
A systematic review of the recent studies found no clear benefit, despite many years of confident public advertising. (對近期研究的系統性回顧發現沒有明顯益處，儘管多年來廣告說得信心滿滿。)
The garden grows large subtropical plants, which survive here only because the winters stay unusually mild and short. (這座花園種著大型亞熱帶植物，它們能在這裡存活，只因為冬天異常溫和短暫。)
Colourful graffiti detracts from the beauty of the old station, although some residents now see it as art. (色彩鮮豔的塗鴉減損了老車站的美感，不過有些居民現在把它視為藝術。)

meaning: vt. 密封 n. 封條；圖章；海豹
example: Workers sealed the old tunnel after the flood, so trains will use the slower coastal route for months. (水災後工人封閉了老隧道，因此列車將改用較慢的沿海路線好幾個月。)

meaning: vt. 使沮喪；使不景氣；降低
example: The poor sales figures depressed the whole team, although the manager insisted that spring would bring real improvement. (難看的銷售數字讓整個團隊沮喪，儘管經理堅稱春天會帶來真正的改善。)
Water is scarce in the village, so every drop is used twice. (村裡缺水，所以每一滴水都要用兩次。)
There is clear evidence of ancient settlement here, including tools and the remains of a small stone wall. (這裡有古代定居的明確證據，包括工具和一道小石牆的殘跡。)

meaning: prep. 除……之外 adv. 而且
example: Besides English, she speaks two local languages fluently, which helps her daily work with families across the region. (除了英語，她還能流利說兩種本地語言，這有助她每天與全區家庭互動的工作。)
Take a waterproof jacket, because the weather can change very quickly here. (帶件防水外套，因為這裡的天氣說變就變。)

meaning: adj. 獨有的；排他的；奢華的 n. 獨家新聞
example: The island has an exclusive right to fish in these rich waters. (這座島擁有在這些豐富海域捕魚的專屬權利。)
The majority of members supported the plan, yet the chair insisted on holding another formal vote next month. (多數成員支持這項計畫，但主席堅持下個月再舉行一次正式表決。)
Despite a painful knee injury, she finished the marathon and even slightly improved on her previous best time. (儘管膝傷疼痛，她仍跑完馬拉松，甚至略微刷新自己先前的最佳成績。)
Stir the sugar slowly until it dissolves completely in the warm milk. (慢慢攪拌，讓糖完全溶解在溫牛奶裡。)

meaning: vt. 釋放；發表 n. 釋放；排放
example: The government released the full report on Friday, quietly hoping fewer people would notice its clearly embarrassing conclusions. (政府在週五公布完整報告，悄悄希望較少人注意到其中明顯令人難堪的結論。)
Rescue teams deployed small drones over the forest, which helped them locate all three missing walkers before dark. (救援隊在森林上空部署小型無人機，協助他們在天黑前找到所有三名失蹤的登山客。)

meaning: adj. 最初的；獨創的 n. 原作
example: The original plan was much simpler, but several unnecessary late changes made the whole project far more expensive. (最初的計畫簡單得多，但幾項不必要的後期變更讓整個專案貴了許多。)

meaning: n. 樹枝；分支機構；分店
example: The bank opened a new branch in the village, which saved elderly customers a long weekly bus trip. (銀行在村裡開設新分行，讓年長客戶省下每週漫長的搭車路程。)

meaning: n. 總理；大臣；大學校長
example: The chancellor spoke briefly at the ceremony, praising students for their patience during the long difficult building work. (大學校長在典禮上簡短致詞，讚揚學生在漫長艱難的施工期間展現耐心。)

meaning: adj. 垂直的；豎式的 n. 垂直線
example: The climbers followed a narrow vertical crack in the grey rock face. (攀岩者沿著灰色岩壁上的一道窄垂直裂縫往上爬。)
A herbivore's teeth are wide and flat for grinding plants, while a predator's are sharp for tearing meat. (食草動物的牙齒寬而平，用來磨碎植物；掠食者的牙齒則尖銳，用來撕肉。)

meaning: adj. 平的；固定的 n. 公寓
example: The car had a flat front tyre, so we changed it beside the road in the pouring rain. (車子的前輪爆胎，所以我們在傾盆大雨中於路邊換胎。)
We occasionally hear owls at night, but we have never seen them. (我們偶爾在夜裡聽到貓頭鷹叫，卻從沒見過牠們。)
In the novel, the old harridan rules the household, yet her sharp words hide a deeply lonely past. (小說中，這位兇惡的老婦掌控全家，但她尖銳的話語背後藏著深沉的孤獨過往。)
Cheap student accommodation near the campus is scarce, so many undergraduates share crowded flats far from the library. (校園附近便宜的學生住處很少，因此許多大學生合租離圖書館很遠的擁擠公寓。)

meaning: adj. 靜止的；靜態的 n. 靜電
example: The car remained static for an hour, blocking the narrow lane completely. (車子靜止了一個小時，把窄巷完全堵住。)
The sports section of the local newspaper is longer than the news pages, which annoys some older readers. (地方報紙的體育版比新聞版還長，這讓一些較年長的讀者很反感。)

meaning: n. 規模；刻度；等級 vt. 攀登
example: The full scale of the damage only became clear the next morning. (損失的完整規模直到第二天早上才清楚。)
The old tap drips constantly, and the sound keeps me awake at night. (老水龍頭不停地滴水，那個聲音讓我晚上睡不著。)
This common ailment usually clears up within a week, yet it can be dangerous for very young babies. (這種常見小病通常一週內就好，但對非常年幼的嬰兒可能有危險。)
The team failed to adhere to the original schedule, so the launch was delayed by almost three months. (團隊未能遵守原定時程，因此發射延後了將近三個月。)
Extracurricular sports keep teenagers active, but they can also easily crowd out all homework on busy weekday evenings. (課外運動讓青少年保持活躍，但也可能輕易佔掉忙碌平日晚上所有的功課時間。)
The wind propelled the small boat across the bay in an hour. (風把小船推過海灣，只花了一小時。)
Good posture matters more than a soft chair when you sit for hours. (坐上好幾個小時時，姿勢正確比椅子柔軟更重要。)

meaning: adj. 海外的 adv. 在海外
example: The company rapidly expanded into new overseas markets, which brought fresh income but also several unfamiliar legal risks. (公司迅速拓展新的海外市場，帶來新收入，卻也帶來幾項陌生的法律風險。)
The country industrialised its farming sector quickly, although small family farms struggled to compete with huge modern factories. (這個國家迅速將農業部門工業化，儘管小型家庭農場難以與巨型現代工廠競爭。)
He built a business empire from one small shop, yet his children have little interest in running it. (他從一家小店建立起商業帝國，但他的孩子對經營它興趣缺缺。)
The mechanic listened to the engine and knew the problem at once. (技工聽了一下引擎，馬上就知道問題在哪。)

meaning: n. 骨折；斷裂 v. 斷裂
example: He suffered a small fracture in his wrist after the fall from the wall. (他從牆上摔下來後，手腕有輕微骨折。)
Progress on the new bridge has been glacial, and frustrated commuters have started organising peaceful weekly protests outside town hall. (新橋工程進度如冰川般緩慢，受挫的通勤族開始每週在市政廳外發起和平抗議。)
They play badminton in the old school hall on rainy winter afternoons. (下雨的冬日午後，他們在舊學校禮堂打羽毛球。)

meaning: n. 碼頭；船塢 v. 靠碼頭
example: The fishing boats return to the dock before the light finally fades. (漁船在天色終於變暗前回到碼頭。)
The strongest argument for change is simply cost, since the old system wastes both money and staff time. (支持改變最有力的理由就是成本，因為舊制度既浪費金錢也浪費員工時間。)

meaning: v. 追捕；追求 n. 追逐
example: She moved to the city to chase her dream, although her worried parents urged her to stay nearby. (她搬到城市追逐夢想，儘管憂心的父母力勸她留在附近。)
The holiday brochure promised quiet beaches, but the resort was crowded and the loud music played all night. (度假小冊子承諾寧靜海灘，但度假村擁擠，吵鬧的音樂還整夜播放。)
The salesman tried hard to convince us that the cheaper model was actually better, but we remained doubtful. (推銷員極力想說服我們較便宜的型號其實更好，但我們仍心存懷疑。)
The old quarter teems with cheap small restaurants, which makes it very popular with students on a budget. (舊城區滿是便宜的小餐館，因此很受預算有限的學生歡迎。)
He finally confronted his fear of public speaking, joining a small local club that meets every Tuesday evening. (他終於面對公開演講的恐懼，加入一個每週二晚上聚會的小型地方社團。)
The exhibition of local pottery runs until the end of the month. (本地陶藝展覽展出到這個月底。)
The north is wet and green, whereas the south is dry and brown. (北部潮溼翠綠，而南部乾燥褐黃。)
An old oak stands at the gate and shades the whole yard. (大門旁有一棵老橡樹，為整個院子遮蔭。)
The school needs additional funding for new books, yet the council has frozen its budget for three years. (學校需要額外經費買新書，但市公所已凍結預算三年。)
The two nurses have overlapping shifts, which gives them half an hour to discuss each patient's care properly. (兩名護理師的班次重疊，讓她們有半小時好好討論每位病人的照護。)
Poultry farming has expanded rapidly in this region, although neighbours complain about the smell during hot summer months. (這一帶的家禽養殖迅速擴張，儘管鄰居抱怨炎熱夏季期間的氣味。)
Regular gentle exercise during pregnancy often improves sleep, yet doctors advise women to avoid serious exhaustion and overheating. (懷孕期間規律的溫和運動常能改善睡眠，但醫師建議女性避免過度疲累和過熱。)
The clinic immediately sent confirmation of the appointment by simple text, which many older patients found unexpectedly helpful. (診所立刻用簡單簡訊傳送預約確認，許多較年長的病人覺得意外地有幫助。)
He read the sentence aloud, saying quote, the evidence remains weak, unquote, then slowly closed the thick file. (他大聲讀出那句話，說「引文開始：證據仍然薄弱，引文結束」，然後慢慢闔上厚厚的檔案。)
The small charity discovered embezzlement last year, and the former treasurer has since repaid part of the money. (這家小型慈善機構去年發現盜用公款，前財務長此後已歸還部分款項。)
The acrobatic birds swoop between narrow buildings, catching tiny insects in mid-air with astonishing speed and great precision. (這些雜技般的鳥在狹窄建築間俯衝，以驚人的速度和極高的精準度在空中捕捉小昆蟲。)
Numerous small streams cross the field and make walking rather difficult here. (田裡有許多小溪橫過，這裡走起來相當困難。)
From the balcony we could see the whole harbour and the hills. (從陽臺可以看到整個港口和山丘。)
She is a postgraduate now and teaches two classes to pay her rent. (她現在是研究生，教兩堂課來付房租。)
Gardening improves her well-being more than any medicine she has ever tried. (種花蒔草對她身心安寧的幫助，勝過她試過的任何藥。)
The inspector chose three boxes at random and opened every one of them. (稽查員隨機挑了三個箱子，全部打開檢查。)
This old bridge is a prime example of Victorian engineering, although it now needs some urgent expensive repairs. (這座老橋是維多利亞時代工程的典型例子，不過現在需要一些急迫而昂貴的整修。)

meaning: v. 定居；解決；支付；飛落
example: The two families finally settled their long dispute over the fence, avoiding a costly and public court case. (兩家人終於解決了長久以來的圍籬爭議，避免了一場昂貴又公開的官司。)
Fallow land provides useful shelter for nesting birds, which is why some farmers deliberately leave a strip untilled. (休耕地為築巢的鳥提供有用的庇護，因此有些農民刻意留一條未耕的帶狀地。)
The theatre troupe tours small remote villages, performing in halls that have no proper stage or even lighting. (這個劇團巡演偏遠小村，在沒有正式舞台、甚至沒有燈光的禮堂裡演出。)
The study rests on the premise that remote work reduces commuting, an assumption that recent data partly supports. (這份研究建立在遠距工作能減少通勤的前提上，而近期資料部分支持這項假設。)

meaning: adj. 有識別力的；眼光敏銳的
example: A discerning shopper carefully compares quality before price, which is why this small shop keeps many loyal customers. (眼光敏銳的顧客會先比較品質再看價格，這就是這家小店能留住許多忠實顧客的原因。)

meaning: v. 挑剔；拘泥小節；煩擾
example: One small doubt kept niggling at him throughout the long flight: had he really locked the office safe? (一個小小的疑慮在漫長飛行途中不斷困擾他：他真的鎖好辦公室的保險箱了嗎？)
The university prospectus claims excellent facilities, yet students say the science laboratories have not been updated for years. (大學簡章宣稱設備優良，但學生說科學實驗室已多年未更新。)
She liaises with overseas suppliers daily, ensuring that every crucial order normally arrives before the busy Christmas season. (她每天與海外供應商聯絡，確保每筆關鍵訂單通常都能在繁忙的耶誕季前到貨。)
The excavation for the new road uncovered animal bones, so work stopped while archaeologists carefully examined the site. (新道路的挖掘工程發現動物骨骸，因此工程暫停，由考古學家仔細勘查現場。)

meaning: adj. 歐洲大陸的；大陸性的 n. 歐洲大陸人
example: The hotel serves a simple continental breakfast, which suits guests who prefer something light before an early flight. (飯店提供簡單的歐陸式早餐，適合喜歡在早班飛機前吃點輕食的客人。)
Modernism in literature broke old narrative rules, yet many readers still find its experiments difficult and rather cold. (文學中的現代主義打破舊有的敘事規則，但許多讀者仍覺得它的實驗手法艱澀又相當冷淡。)
The main artery to the coast was closed for a week after the landslide. (通往海岸的主要幹道在山崩後封閉了一週。)

meaning: adj. 優質的；售價高的 n. 保險金；獎品
example: The premium ticket includes a hot meal, but most passengers decide it is not worth the extra cost. (優質票包含一份熱餐，但多數乘客認為不值得多付這筆錢。)
The glamor of city life faded once she had to pay her own rent. (一旦得自己付房租，城市生活的魅力就消退了。)

meaning: n. 烤肉架；燒烤野餐 v. 燒烤
example: We held an unexpected barbecue in the garden, although dark clouds suddenly threatened heavy rain throughout the whole afternoon. (我們在花園舉辦了一場臨時的烤肉，儘管整個下午烏雲密布，突然有下大雨的跡象。)

meaning: n. 材料；素材 adj. 物質的；重要的
example: The clinic provides useful reading material for waiting patients, which makes the long queues feel much less frustrating. (診所為候診病人提供實用的閱讀材料，讓漫長的排隊感覺不那麼令人挫折。)
They carefully adapted the old barn into a bright studio, keeping the wooden beams and adding large windows. (他們仔細地把老穀倉改建成明亮的工作室，保留木樑並加裝大窗戶。)

meaning: adv. 輕信地；易受欺騙地
example: He gullibly trusted a stranger with his heavy luggage, and it completely disappeared before the train even left. (他輕信陌生人，把沉重的行李交給對方，結果火車還沒開動行李就完全消失了。)
A succession of dry summers has left the reservoir almost half empty. (連續幾個乾燥的夏天，讓水庫幾乎少了一半的水。)
Detectives carefully sifted the evidence for weeks, yet they found nothing that clearly linked the two possible cases. (警探仔細篩查證據好幾週，卻找不到任何能明確連結這兩起可能案件的事物。)
A single spark from the fire landed on the dry grass nearby. (一顆火花從火堆迸出，落在旁邊的乾草上。)
He has little sympathy for people who ignore the basic safety rules. (他對不理會基本安全規定的人沒什麼同情。)

meaning: v. （使）變冷 n. 寒意 adj. 寒冷的
example: A sudden chill of fear ran through the whole packed crowd when the old lights abruptly went out. (老舊的燈光突然熄滅時，一股突如其來的恐懼寒意掠過整群擁擠的人。)

meaning: adj. 多國的 n. 跨國公司
example: The multinational employs half the town, so its sudden decision to close would devastate the entire local economy. (這家跨國公司僱用全鎮一半的人，因此它突然決定關廠會重創整個地方經濟。)
Long daily exposure to loud noise damages hearing, yet many factory workers still refuse to wear proper protection. (每天長時間暴露在噪音中會損害聽力，但許多工廠工人仍拒絕配戴適當的防護裝備。)
Competition between the two supermarkets is increasingly fierce, so both keep cutting prices to attract nearby local shoppers. (兩家超市之間的競爭日益激烈，因此雙方都不斷降價來吸引附近的本地顧客。)
Financial crime is very hard to detect, because the culprits often hide behind respectable companies and clever paperwork. (金融犯罪很難偵破，因為犯案者常躲在體面的公司和精巧的文書背後。)
Women constitute more than half of the students in this small college. (女性佔這所小學院學生的一半以上。)
The advertisement deceived many buyers into thinking the shoes were real leather. (這則廣告讓許多買家誤以為鞋子是真皮。)
Fishermen hauled the heavy nets onto the wooden boat just before sunrise. (漁民在日出前把沉重的漁網拖上木船。)
The city's new emission targets are ambitious, yet traffic still continues to grow much faster than public transport. (這座城市的新排放目標很積極，但車流成長的速度仍遠快於公共運輸。)
A long procession of cars followed the bride to the village church. (長長的車隊跟著新娘前往村裡的教堂。)
A tiny bistro opened beside the river, serving simple cheap food to walkers and cyclists throughout the summer. (河邊開了一家小餐館，整個夏天為健行者和自行車族提供簡單便宜的食物。)

meaning: v. 碰撞；墜落；破產 n. 碰撞；墜毀
example: The truck crashed into the roadside barrier but nobody was seriously hurt. (卡車撞上路旁的護欄，但沒有人受重傷。)
She wore a single white pearl on a very thin silver chain. (她戴著一顆白珍珠，掛在細細的銀鍊上。)

meaning: n. 勞動人口；全體員工
example: Half the workforce is over fifty, and few young people apply for jobs. (一半的勞動人口超過五十歲，而年輕人很少來應徵。)
She surpassed the old national record by two seconds, which surprised even her coach and the cheering crowd. (她以兩秒之差刷新舊的全國紀錄，這連她的教練和歡呼的觀眾都感到驚訝。)
Sociology research clearly shows that neighbourhood design affects trust, so small shared gardens may strengthen local community ties. (社會學研究清楚顯示，社區設計會影響信任，因此小型共用花園可能強化地方社群連結。)
The violent protest damaged several shop windows, and the mayor called for calm during a short televised speech. (這場暴力抗議破壞了幾家商店的櫥窗，市長在簡短的電視演說中呼籲冷靜。)
Her mother sewed the frock by hand, adding small delicate pearls that had belonged to her own grandmother. (她母親親手縫製這件連衣裙，還加上原本屬於她祖母的小巧精緻珍珠。)

meaning: n. 流行病；盛行 adj. 流行性的
example: Doctors describe obesity as a growing epidemic, yet prevention still receives far less public funding than treatment does. (醫師將肥胖描述為日益嚴重的流行病，但預防獲得的公共經費仍遠少於治療。)
He grabbed his coat quickly and ran for the last bus home. (他匆匆抓起外套，跑去趕最後一班回家的公車。)
A bronze statue of the founder stands in front of the library. (圖書館前立著創辦人的銅像。)
Old kitchen appliances can be left at the recycling centre for free. (舊廚房家電可以免費送到回收中心。)
The new sports facility is open to all local residents at weekends. (新的運動設施週末開放給所有本地居民使用。)
The only real consolation was a small refund, which hardly covered even half the cost of their ruined holiday. (唯一真正的安慰是一筆小額退款，卻連他們假期泡湯的一半費用都不夠。)
The bread has a dense texture and a slightly sour, nutty taste. (這款麵包質地紮實，帶點微酸和堅果味。)
The plan was based on the assumption that the river would stay low. (這個計畫基於一個假設：河水會一直維持低水位。)

meaning: adj. 不滿意的；不滿足的
example: Dissatisfied customers rarely simply complain directly, so the company quietly loses them without ever learning the real reason. (不滿意的顧客很少直接抱怨，因此公司悄悄流失他們，卻從不知道真正原因。)
The simultaneous arrival of two ferries caused a queue at the gate. (兩艘渡輪同時抵達，讓閘口排起長龍。)
The sundial in the garden is accurate to within a few minutes. (花園裡的日晷誤差只有幾分鐘。)
The soil near the old factory is toxic and cannot be farmed. (舊工廠附近的土壤有毒，不能耕作。)
The new design cleverly utilises every corner of the small flat, creating useful storage where none seemed possible. (新設計巧妙利用小公寓的每個角落，在看似不可能的地方創造實用收納。)
Strict conformity in schools can discourage creativity, yet some parents still prefer uniforms and very clear discipline rules. (學校裡的嚴格從眾可能抑制創造力，但有些家長仍偏好制服和非常明確的紀律規定。)
Clubs often overrate promising young talent, paying huge salaries before players have proved themselves at the top level. (球團往往高估有潛力的年輕人才，在球員於頂級賽場證明自己前就支付高薪。)
The volcano has been dormant for two hundred years but is still watched. (這座火山已休眠兩百年，但仍受到監測。)

meaning: vt. 取代；迫使離開家園
example: The flood displaced hundreds of families who had lived near the river. (水災迫使數百戶原本住在河邊的家庭離開家園。)

meaning: v. 擁抱；包括；欣然接受 n. 擁抱
example: Small farms have embraced the new method of growing rice without chemicals. (小型農場欣然接受了不用化學藥劑種稻的新方法。)
They engraved the date inside the ring, so the memory would survive even if the metal wore thin. (他們把日期刻在戒指內側，這樣即使金屬磨薄，回憶仍能留存。)
It is disrespectful to publicly mock someone's strong accent online, even when you clearly disagree with their opinion. (在網路上公開嘲笑別人濃重的口音很無禮，即使你明確不同意對方的觀點。)
Cameras in staff changing rooms invade privacy, which is why the gym removed them after several angry complaints. (員工更衣室裡的攝影機侵犯隱私，因此健身房在幾起憤怒投訴後把它們拆除。)

meaning: n. 拱廊；有拱廊的街道
example: The video arcade was noisy and dim, yet local teenagers treated it as a second home after school. (電玩遊藝場又吵又暗，但當地青少年放學後把它當成第二個家。)

meaning: n. 實況報導；評論；註釋
example: His political commentary is sharp but surprisingly fair, which explains why many rival newspapers still regularly quote him. (他的政治評論犀利卻意外公正，這說明了為何許多競爭報紙仍經常引用他的話。)
The film recreates a busy village market so carefully that local older viewers can clearly recognise individual stalls. (這部電影如此細膩地重現繁忙的村莊市集，當地年長觀眾能清楚認出一個個攤位。)

meaning: v. 嘲笑；模仿 adj. 模擬的；假的
example: Comedians mocked the new policy for weeks, yet the government publicly refused to admit its many obvious mistakes. (喜劇演員嘲諷這項新政策好幾週，但政府公開拒絕承認其許多明顯錯誤。)
The male marks his territory carefully, clearly warning other young animals to stay away during the breeding season. (雄性動物小心地標記地盤，明確警告其他年輕動物在繁殖季保持距離。)
Many schools strictly prohibit mobile phones during lessons, although parents want to reach their children in sudden emergencies. (許多學校嚴格禁止上課時使用手機，儘管家長希望在突發緊急狀況時能聯絡孩子。)
The first shipment of coffee left the port at the end of March. (第一批裝運的咖啡在三月底離開港口。)
The yearly village calendar lists every fair and concert, so residents can plan their summer holidays around them. (村裡的年度月曆列出每場市集和音樂會，居民可據此安排暑假。)

meaning: n. 魔法；魔力 adj. 神奇的
example: The old story is full of magic, talking animals and hidden doors. (這個古老的故事充滿魔法、會說話的動物和暗門。)

meaning: v. 滑倒；溜走；塞入 n. 差錯；紙片
example: He slipped on the narrow icy path, but a kind passer-by caught his arm before he could fall. (他在狹窄結冰的小路上滑倒，但一位善心路人及時抓住他的手臂，他才沒跌倒。)

meaning: v. 破碎；給予極大打擊
example: The glass shattered on the floor, and we spent an hour sweeping. (玻璃在地上碎了一地，我們花了一小時清掃。)
The two families called a truce so that the wedding could go ahead. (兩家人暫時休戰，好讓婚禮順利舉行。)

meaning: n. 折扣 vt. 打折；低估
example: The garage offers a discount to older customers, which has brought them a steady stream of loyal business. (這家修車廠給年長顧客折扣，為他們帶來源源不絕的忠實生意。)

meaning: adj. 艱難的；健壯的；老的
example: It was a tough decision to sell the old family home, but the stairs had become increasingly dangerous. (賣掉老家是個艱難的決定，但樓梯已變得越來越危險。)

meaning: n. 志願者 v. 自願做 adj. 志願的
example: Hospital volunteers regularly read to elderly patients, which often brightens long afternoons for people with very few visitors. (醫院志工定期為年長病人朗讀，常為鮮少有人探視的人照亮漫長的午後。)
The eruption covered the village in grey ash but caused no deaths. (火山爆發讓村莊覆滿灰燼，但沒有造成死亡。)
His pension is small, so he still works two days a week. (他的養老金不多，所以每週還工作兩天。)
The homework assignment asked students to interview a local neighbour, which produced unexpectedly vivid stories about the area. (這項家庭作業要求學生訪問一位當地鄰居，結果產生了關於這個地區意外生動的故事。)
The teacher carefully assigned seats alphabetically, quietly hoping the new arrangement would reduce constant chatting during afternoon lessons. (老師仔細按字母安排座位，暗自希望新安排能減少下午上課時不斷的聊天。)
The concert in the park was free, and hundreds of families came. (公園裡的音樂會免費，來了數百個家庭。)
The microbiology laboratory tests routine food samples, checking for harmful bacteria that could quickly cause very serious illness. (微生物實驗室檢驗常規食品樣本，檢查可能迅速造成非常嚴重疾病的有害細菌。)
The kitchen has stainless steel surfaces that are very easy to clean. (廚房用不鏽鋼檯面，很容易清理。)
The hallowed ground around the old temple is kept free of shops. (老廟周圍這片神聖的土地不准設攤。)

meaning: n. 終點站；航站樓 adj. 末端的
example: The bus terminal is only a ten-minute walk from the ferry pier. (客運總站離渡輪碼頭走路只要十分鐘。)
The current business climate favours small local firms, yet many still struggle to find enough properly skilled workers. (目前的商業環境有利於地方小企業，但許多仍在苦苦尋找足夠的合格技術人力。)
The smell of hot soup soon brought her around after she fainted. (她昏倒後，熱湯的氣味很快讓她恢復了意識。)
Students often question the relevance of basic algebra, yet it quietly underpins many important everyday decisions about money. (學生常質疑基礎代數的相關性，但它悄悄支撐著許多重要的日常金錢決定。)
The witness was reluctant to speak, but a quiet private interview eventually revealed what she had clearly seen. (證人不願開口，但一次安靜的私下訪談最後揭露了她清楚看到的事。)
The regularity of gentle daily exercise clearly matters more than its intensity, according to several recent long-term studies. (根據幾項近期長期研究，每天溫和運動的規律性明顯比強度更重要。)
Researchers study laterality in wild animals, hoping to clearly understand why most humans strongly favour their right hand. (研究者研究野生動物的偏側性，希望清楚了解為何多數人強烈偏好右手。)

meaning: adj. 主要的；盛行的；突出的
example: Blue is the predominant colour in the old painting, although small patches of bright red draw the eye. (藍色是這幅老畫的主要色調，不過幾小塊鮮紅仍吸引目光。)

meaning: n. 艱苦跋涉 vi. 長途跋涉
example: The trek through the deep snow took two days, and the group slept in a basic mountain hut. (穿越深雪的艱苦跋涉花了兩天，一行人睡在一間簡陋的山屋。)
The complicated rules daunt many new beginners, so the club now offers a free short introductory session every month. (複雜的規則讓許多新手上步，因此社團現在每月提供一次免費的短期入門課程。)
Our itinerary includes three nights by the lake and two in the hills. (我們的行程表包括湖邊三晚、山區兩晚。)

meaning: v. 適應新環境；服水土
example: It took her months to acclimatise to new city life, although the job itself was easier than expected. (她花了好幾個月才適應新的城市生活，儘管工作本身比預期容易。)
Cows grazed in the meadow below the farm until the rain came. (下雨前，牛在農場下方的草地吃草。)
The forthcoming festival will close two busy streets in the old town. (即將到來的節慶將封閉舊城區兩條熱鬧的街道。)

meaning: n. 結構；建築物 vt. 組織；安排
example: Family structure has changed greatly in recent decades, and more grandparents now increasingly help with regular daily childcare. (家庭結構近幾十年來變化很大，越來越多祖父母如今分擔規律的日常托育。)
A large quantity of sand was brought in to widen the beach. (為了拓寬海灘，運來大量沙子。)

meaning: adj. 不可或缺的；完整的
example: Bees are an integral part of farming, yet their numbers are falling. (蜜蜂是農業不可或缺的一環，但數量正在減少。)
The course involves two weeks of intensive training before the final exam. (這門課程在期末考之前有兩週密集訓練。)
He acknowledged that the long delay was entirely his fault and apologised. (他承認這次長時間的延誤完全是他的錯，並道歉。)
The shop is not allowed to sell liquor after ten at night. (這家店晚上十點以後不得賣烈酒。)
She had the presence of mind to quickly call for help, which probably saved the young climber's life. (她臨危不亂，迅速呼救，這很可能救了那位年輕登山者的命。)
Children develop basic language skills fastest when adults talk and read with them regularly, not merely at them. (當大人經常陪孩子說話、閱讀，而不只是對他們說話時，孩子的基礎語言能力發展得最快。)

meaning: v. 爆破 n. 爆炸；一陣（大風）
example: A blast of cold air hit us when the door opened, and everyone reached for a heavy coat. (門一開，一股冷風撲向我們，大家都伸手去拿厚外套。)
We had warm rice pudding with cinnamon and raisins for Sunday dessert. (星期日的甜點是加了肉桂和葡萄乾的溫熱米布丁。)
Your generous help during the move was greatly appreciated, especially since we had so very little time left. (你搬家時慷慨的幫忙讓我們非常感激，尤其是我們剩下的時間那麼少。)
He attended science classes only sporadically, which made it really hard for teachers to assess his true progress. (他只有零星去上科學課，這讓老師很難真正評估他的實際進步。)
Young birds imitate the songs of the adults in their own group. (幼鳥會模仿同群成鳥的鳴唱。)
The new constitution clearly limits presidential power, although critics say several key articles remain deliberately vague and weak. (新憲法明確限制總統權力，儘管批評者說有幾條關鍵條文仍刻意含糊而薄弱。)
Wildlife photography requires great patience and a very steady pair of hands. (拍攝野生動物需要很大的耐心和一雙很穩的手。)
The engineer finally replaced the slow old modem, which immediately doubled the speed of our reliable home connection. (工程師終於換掉老舊的慢速數據機，我們可靠的家用網路速度立刻加倍。)

meaning: vt. 提倡；擁護 n. 擁護者；提倡者
example: She advocates walking to school instead of driving such a short distance. (她提倡走路去學校，而不是為這麼短的距離開車。)
Road maintenance has been postponed yet again, so drivers must cope with deep potholes throughout the whole winter. (道路保養又一再延後，因此駕駛整個冬天都得應付深坑洞。)
A spouse's career often really determines where a family lives, which complicates careful long-term planning for both partners. (配偶的職業往往真正決定一家人住哪裡，這讓雙方伴侶的長期規劃變得複雜。)
The furnace broke down, and the house stayed cold for two days. (暖氣爐壞了，屋裡冷了兩天。)
The expedition set off before dawn with six mules and a guide. (探險隊帶著六頭騾子和一位嚮導，天亮前出發。)
An incendiary post deliberately spread quickly online, and senior officials struggled to calm the public anger it created. (一篇煽動性貼文刻意在網路上迅速傳播，資深官員難以平息它引發的群眾怒火。)
The rapid expansion of the town has swallowed most of the orchards. (城鎮快速擴張，把大部分果園都吞掉了。)
The pipes are encased in thick concrete to protect them from frost. (管子外面包著厚混凝土，以防結霜受損。)

meaning: adj. 無效的；有病的 n. 病弱者
example: The ticket is invalid if the date has been changed by hand. (車票上的日期若被手改過就失效。)

meaning: adj. 公正的；沒有偏見的
example: Good financial advice should be truly unbiased, yet many advisers earn secret commission from the products they recommend. (好的理財建議應真正公正，但許多顧問從他們推薦的產品中賺取祕密佣金。)
They postponed the match because the playing field was still under water. (因為球場還積著水，他們把比賽延期。)
I skimmed the report on the train and marked two pages to read again. (我在火車上瀏覽那份報告，標了兩頁要再看。)

meaning: n. 序言；引言 vt. 為……寫序言
example: In the preface, the author thanks the many farmers who helped her. (作者在序言中感謝許多協助她的農民。)
The company struggles to retain young skilled staff, because salaries here still remain far below the national average. (公司難以留住年輕的技術員工，因為這裡的薪資仍遠低於全國平均。)
Months of negotiation finally culminated in a small quiet agreement, which surprisingly few outside the industry actually noticed. (數月的談判終於達成一項低調的小協議，業界外實際注意到的人少得令人意外。)
His robotic movements clearly suggested complete exhaustion, yet he simply refused to stop until the long shift ended. (他呆板的動作明顯透露出徹底的疲累，但他就是不肯停下來，直到漫長的班結束。)

meaning: n. 側面輪廓；人物簡介 vt. 扼要介紹
example: Her online profile had clearly exaggerated her experience, which embarrassed her when colleagues quietly pointed out several errors. (她的線上簡介明顯誇大了經歷，同事悄悄指出幾處錯誤時讓她很尷尬。)
Rising salinity in the river threatens local fish, so farmers upstream are being paid to use less water. (河水鹽分上升威脅當地魚類，因此上游農民可獲補助以減少用水。)
The aggravation of his knee injury kept him off the team for months. (膝傷惡化，讓他好幾個月無法上場。)
A small incident at the gate delayed the start of the concert. (門口的小事件讓音樂會延後開始。)
Her previous job was far more stressful, although it still paid noticeably much better than her current one. (她以前的工作壓力大得多，儘管薪水仍明顯比現在這份好很多。)

meaning: n. 香料；調味品 vt. 加香料；增添趣味
example: A little spice makes the soup taste much better on a cold day. (天氣冷時，加一點香料能讓湯好喝得多。)

meaning: v. 使厭煩；鑽孔 n. 討厭的人
example: Museums easily bore some children, yet interactive exhibits can turn a dull visit into a genuinely memorable afternoon. (博物館容易讓一些孩子覺得無聊，但互動展覽能把枯燥的參觀變成真正難忘的下午。)

meaning: n. 間歇；平靜期 v. 使昏昏欲睡
example: During a brief lull in the storm, we ran to the car. (趁暴風雨短暫的間歇，我們跑向車子。)
This county borders three others, which so often makes regional transport planning genuinely complicated and highly politically sensitive. (這個縣與三個縣相鄰，這常讓區域交通規劃變得真正複雜，且政治高度敏感。)
Publishing her private messages would betray a basic trust, so the editor refused despite the obvious commercial temptation. (公布她的私人訊息會背棄基本的信任，因此編輯儘管面對明顯的商業誘惑仍拒絕。)

meaning: adj. 根本的；潛在的；下層的
example: Treating the symptoms alone will not solve the underlying problem, which has troubled the clinic for many years. (只治療症狀無法解決根本問題，而這個問題已困擾診所多年。)

meaning: adj. 令人沮喪的；使人氣餒的
example: The dispiriting news arrived early on Monday, when the factory confirmed that two hundred local jobs would go. (令人沮喪的消息在週一清晨傳來，工廠確認將裁掉兩百個當地工作。)

meaning: adj. 豪華的；富裕的；豐富的
example: The wedding was surprisingly opulent, with fresh flowers in every corner and a live band that played until sunrise. (這場婚禮豪華得令人意外，每個角落都有鮮花，還有現場樂團演奏到日出。)

meaning: adj. 豪華的；舒適的 n. 長毛絨

meaning: adj. 最初的；詞首的 n. 詞首大寫字母

meaning: n. 憲章；包租 vt. 包租；特許設立
example: The charter gives the town the right to hold a weekly market. (這份憲章賦予這個鎮每週舉辦市集的權利。)

meaning: adj. 可怕的；難以克服的
example: She is a truly formidable opponent, yet she always praises her rivals generously whenever the tense match ends. (她是個真正難以對付的對手，但每當緊張的比賽結束，她總是慷慨讚美對手。)

meaning: n. 接力賽；中繼裝置 vt. 傳送；轉播
example: Our team came second in the relay despite losing a running shoe. (我們隊在接力賽中拿到第二，儘管有人跑掉了鞋子。)

She stopped at the threshold and looked back at the empty room. (她在門檻前停下，回頭看著空蕩的房間。)

meaning: n. 草稿；匯票；氣流 vt. 起草；徵召

Higher fines may really deter some young drivers, yet experts doubt they will change risky everyday habits much. (提高罰款或許真能嚇阻一些年輕駕駛，但專家懷疑這對改變危險的日常習慣作用不大。)

meaning: adj. 有希望的；有前途的
example: The young player is promising, but he still needs to train harder. (這位年輕球員很有前途，但還需要更努力訓練。)
Her first goal was to run a full local marathon, and she quietly trained for almost eighteen months. (她的第一個目標是跑完一場當地全程馬拉松，而她默默訓練了將近十八個月。)
Workers crush the dark grapes gently, because bitter seeds would otherwise easily spoil the wine's delicate natural flavour. (工人輕輕壓碎深色葡萄，否則苦澀的籽很容易破壞葡萄酒細緻的天然風味。)

meaning: n. 溪流；一股 v. 流出
example: A steady stream of traffic constantly passes the busy school, which worries many parents at morning dropping-off time. (穩定的車流不斷經過這所繁忙的學校，這讓許多家長在早晨接送時很擔心。)

Shops maximise profit by placing daily essentials at the back, forcing customers to walk past every tempting display. (商店把日常必需品放在最後面來最大化利潤，迫使顧客走過每個誘人的陳列。)

meaning: adj. 光滑的；時髦的；豪華的

meaning: adj. 廢棄的；破敗的 n. 無家可歸者

meaning: n. 傳單；小冊子 v. 散發傳單

meaning: v. 孵化；策劃 n. 艙門；開口

meaning: n. 倡議；主動性；主動權

meaning: n. 小路；跑道；軌道 v. 追蹤

meaning: adj. 多產的；富有成效的

meaning: vi. 爬行；緩慢進行 n. 自由泳

meaning: n. 專利；專利權 adj. 顯而易見的 vt. 取得專利

meaning: adj. 強壯的；健壯的；堅定的

meaning: adj. 強烈的；緊張的；熱切的

meaning: v. 收回；撤退；退出；提款

meaning: vi. 閃爍；一閃而過 n. 閃爍

meaning: adj. 較低的；下面的 v. 降低；減少

meaning: adj. 主要的；初級的；最初的

meaning: n. 凌亂 v. 弄亂；弄糟

meaning: n. 設計；圖樣 v. 設計；構思

meaning: n. 全體船員；工作人員

meaning: adj. 同情的；支持的；和諧的

You can personalize the notebook by writing your name on the cover. (你可以在封面寫上名字，讓筆記本成為個人物品。)

meaning: adj. 不相容的；不協調的

meaning: n. 複雜性；複雜的事物

meaning: n. 委託；佣金 v. 授權；委託

meaning: n. 問題；發行；（報刊）一期 vt. 發行；分發

meaning: n. 野生動物；野生生物

meaning: v. 吞嚥；忍受 n. 燕子

meaning: n. 原料；材料 vt. 填進；吃飽

meaning: adj. 向陸的 adv. 向陸地
example: The landward migration of fish clearly surprised researchers, who had expected them to move towards deeper open water. (魚群向陸遷移明顯讓研究者意外，他們原以為魚會游向更深的開闊水域。)

meaning: adj. 有力的；充滿活力的

meaning: n. 下屬 adj. 下級的；次要的 vt. 使服從

meaning: n. 告別；歡送會 int. 再會

meaning: v. 存活；倖免於；比……長命

meaning: n. 延長；延長部分；分機

meaning: n. 犧牲；祭品 v. 犧牲；獻祭
example: His parents made great sacrifices so that he could study medicine abroad. (他父母做出很大的犧牲，讓他能出國讀醫學。)

meaning: vi. 退化 adj. 退化的
example: Without regular care, the garden will quickly degenerate into a patch of weeds. (如果沒有定期照料，花園很快就會退化成一片雜草。)
This intelligent software learns from user behaviour, which clearly helps it block most suspicious messages before they arrive. (這套智慧軟體會從使用者行為中學習，這明顯有助它在多數可疑訊息送達前加以攔阻。)
A local historian traced the family's records back to the eighteenth century. (一位地方歷史學家把這家族的紀錄追溯到十八世紀。)

meaning: adj. 別緻的 vt. 想像 n. 想像力

The storm caused considerable damage to roofs along the whole eastern coast. (暴風雨對東岸的屋頂造成相當大的損害。)
His clumsy attempt to apologise made everyone laugh instead of forgiving him. (他笨拙的道歉反而讓大家笑了，沒人原諒他。)

meaning: vi. 閃爍；流露 n. 閃光
example: The wet stones gleam in the sun after a short summer shower. (短暫的夏日陣雨後，濕石頭在陽光下閃爍。)

meaning: n. 塑膠 adj. 塑膠的
example: Much of our ordinary clothing contains hidden plastic, which still sheds tiny fibres every time it is washed. (我們許多日常衣物都含有隱藏的塑膠，每次清洗仍會脫落細微纖維。)
Old maps fascinate him because they show how rivers have changed course. (舊地圖令他著迷，因為它們顯示河流如何改道。)
A senior nurse will supervise the new staff during their first month. (一位資深護理師會在新進人員的第一個月監督他們。)
The committee will evaluate each proposal before deciding where to spend the money. (委員會將評估每份提案，再決定把錢花在哪裡。)
Simple curiosity led him to open the old chest in the attic. (單純的好奇心讓他打開閣樓裡的舊箱子。)
The new factory was built too close to a quiet residential area. (新工廠蓋得離安靜的住宅區太近。)

meaning: adj. 唯一的 n. 鞋底；腳底
example: For many years the ferry was the sole link to the mainland. (多年來，渡輪是通往本土的唯一交通方式。)
A decade of research has improved early treatment, yet many patients still wait months for a correct diagnosis. (十年的研究改善了早期治療，但許多病人仍要等好幾個月才能獲得正確診斷。)

meaning: n. 調查；測量 vt. 調查；測量；俯瞰
example: The staff survey clearly revealed low morale, so managers promised to review workloads before the end of term. (員工調查清楚顯示士氣低落，因此主管承諾在學期結束前檢討工作量。)

meaning: n. 試穿；裝置 adj. 適合的
example: The tailor asked her to come back for a final fitting on Friday. (裁縫請她星期五回來做最後一次試穿。)

meaning: adj. 基本的；初步的；未充分發展的

meaning: n. 儀式；例行公事 adj. 儀式的；例行的
example: Making fresh coffee is a morning ritual that she refuses to hurry. (煮新鮮咖啡是她不肯匆忙帶過的早晨儀式。)

meaning: adj. 立體視覺的；有立體效果的
example: The museum uses stereoscopic images to show the canyon in convincing depth. (博物館用立體影像呈現峽谷，深度感十分逼真。)

meaning: adj. 初步的；預備的 n. 初步做法

meaning: n. 常備劇目；全部節目

Different readers interpret the ending of the novel in very different ways. (不同讀者對小說結局的解讀差異很大。)
A low stone wall marks the perimeter of the old apple orchard. (一道低矮的石牆標出舊果園的周邊。)

meaning: v. 猛拉；猝然一動 n. 抽搐

Thick glass can distort the shape of objects seen through the window. (厚玻璃會使透過窗戶看到的物體形狀扭曲。)
The job involves simple daily filing, answering calls, greeting visitors and so forth, but it requires no heavy lifting. (這份工作包括每天簡單歸檔、接電話、接待訪客等等，但不需要搬重物。)

meaning: vt. 使暴露；揭露；使曝光
example: The documentary exposed serious local corruption, yet the senior officials involved still flatly deny any kind of wrongdoing. (這部紀錄片揭露了嚴重的本地貪腐，但涉入其中的高階官員仍斷然否認有任何不當行為。)

meaning: n. 海綿 v. 用海綿擦
example: She wiped the table with a warm sponge and a little soap. (她用溫熱的海綿和一點肥皂擦桌子。)

meaning: v. 登上；發起；鑲嵌 n. 山

meaning: n. 大字標題；頭條新聞

meaning: v. 坍塌；崩潰；暈倒 n. 倒塌

He grinned when the dog brought back the stick he had thrown. (他把樹枝丟出去，狗叼回來時他咧嘴笑了。)

meaning: adj. 民主的；有民主精神的

meaning: n. 學院；系；全體教員；才能

She sliced a cucumber and added it to the cold noodle salad. (她切了一根黃瓜，加進涼麵沙拉裡。)
The old hospital became a research institution after the new one opened. (新醫院啟用後，舊醫院成了一所研究機構。)

meaning: adj. 奇形怪狀的；怪誕的

meaning: n. 帽子；最高限額 vt. 蓋在……上面

meaning: v. 分開；區分；分居 adj. 分離的；不同的

meaning: n. 壓力；壓迫 vt. 施壓；迫使
example: The pressure at work suddenly increased again, so she eventually asked for two weeks of much-needed unpaid leave. (工作壓力又突然增加，因此她最後申請了兩週亟需的無薪假。)

meaning: adj. 宏偉的；豪華的；極好的

meaning: n. 專題論文；學位論文

meaning: n. 堆；大量 vt. 堆積

meaning: vt. 責怪；責備 n. 責任

meaning: n. 框架；構架 vt. 鑲框

meaning: n. 象徵主義；象徵手法

meaning: adj. 抽象的 n. 摘要 vt. 提取；抽象化

meaning: adj. 有讀寫能力的；博學的

meaning: v. 培養；促進；領養 adj. 收養的

meaning: n. 復興；恢復；重新流行
example: The revival of the old tram line has brought more visitors to town. (舊電車路線的復駛為鎮上帶來更多遊客。)

meaning: adj. 不可避免的；必然的

The large hall is designed to amplify sound without any electronic equipment. (這座大廳的設計能放大聲音，不需任何電子設備。)
Their reliance on one well became a problem during the dry summer. (他們只依賴一口井，在乾旱的夏天成了問題。)

meaning: v. 跳躍；衝 n. 跳躍；激增

meaning: adj. 意識到的；神志清醒的
