Inspectors will investigate why the water in the lake suddenly turned green. (檢查人員將調查湖水為何突然變綠。)

meaning: adv. 在下面 prep. 在……下面 n. 下部
example: A small stream runs underneath, hidden by thick bushes and tall grass. (一條小溪從下面流過，被茂密的灌木和高草遮住。)

meaning: n. 分開；分配；分歧；部門
example: The division of the land into small plots caused years of argument. (土地被分成小塊，引發了多年的爭執。)

meaning: v. 賭博；投機；冒險 n. 賭博
example: He foolishly gambled most of his savings on a single horse race. (他愚蠢地把大部分積蓄賭在一場賽馬上。)
Ancient trees line the narrow path leading up to the hilltop temple. (古老的樹木排列在通往山頂寺廟的窄徑兩旁。)
A single strand of hair caught on the rough wooden door frame. (一根髮絲勾在粗糙的木門框上。)
The museum keeps a rare specimen of the butterfly in a glass case. (博物館把這種蝴蝶的稀有標本保存在玻璃櫃裡。)
The police could find no clear motive for the strange overnight break-in. (警方找不出這起奇怪夜間闖入事件的明確動機。)
He was furious when he found his new bike had been taken. (他發現新腳踏車被騎走時非常生氣。)

meaning: adj. 可供替代的；另類的 n. 替代方案
example: The island heavily invests in alternative energy, since importing fuel by ship still remains very expensive and unreliable. (這座島大力投資替代能源，因為用船進口燃料仍非常昂貴且不可靠。)

meaning: n. 通道；機會；使用權 vt. 進入；使用
example: Rural children often lack access to good local schools, so many families move closer to the nearest town. (鄉村孩子往往缺乏就讀良好本地學校的管道，因此許多家庭搬到最近的城鎮附近。)
The museum documents the old whaling industry, which once employed hundreds of local men along this entire coast. (博物館記錄了舊捕鯨業，這個產業曾在這整段海岸僱用數百名當地男子。)
She felt pure exhilaration as the boat raced across the open bay. (小船疾駛過開闊的海灣時，她感到純粹的興奮。)

meaning: adj. 內陸的 adv. 向內地；向內陸
example: The wind pushed the small boat inland, away from the rocky coast. (風把小船往內陸推，遠離岩石海岸。)
Many young graduates migrate to big cities, hoping for better pay but often finding very high rents instead. (許多年輕畢業生遷往大城市，希望獲得更高薪資，卻往往只遇到非常高的房租。)
The price of a barrel of oil rose sharply, which pushed up transport costs across the whole country. (每桶石油價格大漲，推高了全國的運輸成本。)

meaning: v. 要求；聲稱；索賠 n. 主張；索賠
example: Thousands of families claim monthly housing benefit, yet the application process often still remains very slow and confusing. (數千個家庭申請每月住房補助，但申請流程往往仍非常緩慢且令人困惑。)

meaning: v. 消化；理解 n. 文摘
example: Some people find it hard to digest rich food late at night. (有些人覺得深夜吃油膩食物很難消化。)
It took her nearly an hour to decipher the doctor's handwritten notes. (她花了將近一小時才辨認出醫生手寫的筆記。)

meaning: adj. 非凡的；不同尋常的
example: Her extraordinary talent was quite obvious early, yet she still needed years of careful patient coaching to succeed. (她非凡的天賦很早就相當明顯，但她仍需要多年細心耐心的指導才能成功。)
The light frame is made of aluminium and weighs almost nothing at all. (這個輕巧的框架是鋁製的，幾乎沒有重量。)
The bread had gone stale, so we fed it to the ducks. (麵包變得不新鮮了，所以我們拿去餵鴨子。)
Bargain hunters snapped up the last coats within an hour of opening. (撿便宜的顧客在開店一小時內就把最後一批外套搶購一空。)

meaning: n. 棕褐色；曬黑 v. 曬黑；硝皮
example: He wore tan leather boots that matched his wide brown canvas belt. (他穿著棕褐色的皮靴，和寬帆布腰帶很搭。)
He hung on to the steady job during the long recession, even when the company cut everyone's hours. (在漫長的經濟衰退期間，他一直保住那份穩定的工作，即使公司削減了每個人的工時。)
Loud machinery can impair hearing if workers forget to use ear protection. (工人若忘記使用護耳裝備，吵雜的機械會損害聽力。)

meaning: adj. 不可避免的；難免的
example: There was an inescapable smell of smoke in the old ruined house. (那棟破舊的廢屋裡有一股揮之不去的煙味。)

meaning: n. 青少年 adj. 青春期的
example: Many adolescents need more sleep than their parents and teachers really realise. (許多青少年需要的睡眠比父母和老師真正了解的多。)

meaning: v. 聯想；交往 n. 夥伴；同事 adj. 副的
example: Most visitors immediately associate this old market with the smell of warm fresh bread and very strong coffee. (多數訪客會立刻把這座老市場和溫熱新鮮麵包及濃烈咖啡的氣味聯想在一起。)
A guinea was worth slightly more than one pound in old Britain. (在舊時的英國，一幾尼的價值略高於一英鎊。)
A thick layer of dust covered the shelves in the empty flat. (空公寓的架子上積了一層厚灰。)

meaning: n. 電纜；纜繩；電報 v. 發電報
example: The cable car was closed for long repairs, so we slowly walked all the way up the steep mountain instead. (纜車因長時間維修而停駛，所以我們改為慢慢一路爬上陡峭的山。)

meaning: n. 楔子；楔形 vt. 楔入
example: She cut a small wedge of cheese, adding it to the fresh bread and pickles on the plate. (她切了一小塊楔形起司，放到盤子裡的新鮮麵包和醃黃瓜旁。)
Judicious use of water kept the small garden truly alive, even during the hottest and driest summer month. (明智地用水讓這座小花園真正存活下來，即使在最熱最乾的夏季月份。)

meaning: n. 垃圾掩埋場；垃圾堆
example: The old landfill now collects methane gas, which is burned to directly generate electricity for nearby local homes. (舊垃圾掩埋場現在收集甲烷，燃燒後直接為附近民宅發電。)

meaning: v. 投射；投擲；澆鑄 n. 演員表；鑄件
example: Tall trees cast long shadows across the quiet road in the evening. (傍晚時，高大的樹木在安靜的道路上投下長長的影子。)
The heavy red curtain rose slowly, and the whole audience fell silent as the young actor finally appeared. (厚重的紅色布幕緩緩升起，年輕演員終於現身時，全場觀眾都安靜下來。)

meaning: n. 制服 adj. 相同的；一致的
example: The traditional school uniform was changed last year, although many parents still quietly prefer the simple old design. (傳統校服去年改變了，但許多家長仍默默偏愛簡單的舊設計。)
The path sparkled because it was mixed with fine crushed white quartz. (這條小路閃閃發亮，因為混了細碎的白石英。)
Longitudinal data can clearly reveal gradual changes, which much shorter studies simply cannot reliably detect with any confidence. (縱向資料能清楚揭示逐漸的變化，而短得多的研究根本無法有把握地可靠偵測到。)

meaning: vt. 使醒悟；使不再抱幻想
example: The poor service soon disillusioned the tourists who had read glowing reviews. (糟糕的服務很快讓那些讀過好評的遊客不再抱幻想。)
The little café has a loyal clientele of nearby office and shop workers. (這家小咖啡館有一群忠實顧客，是附近的上班族和店員。)
The clinic takes a holistic approach, considering diet, sleep and stress together. (這家診所採取整體做法，把飲食、睡眠和壓力一起考量。)
The exodus of young families has left the village with few children. (年輕家庭大批離去，使村裡幾乎沒有小孩。)
The festival and the harvest usually concur in the last week of September. (慶典和收成通常在九月最後一週同時發生。)
Preventative checks on the water pipes saved the town a costly repair. (對水管做預防性檢查，為鎮上省下一筆昂貴的維修費。)
The two treatments are complementary, and doctors often use them side by side. (這兩種療法互補，醫生常把它們並用。)
A small garden is a useful adjunct to the old narrow house. (一座小花園是這棟窄小老屋的有用附屬空間。)
The article offers a simplistic answer to a very complex social question. (這篇文章對一個非常複雜的社會問題給了過分簡化的答案。)

meaning: n. 打嗝；小挫折 vi. 打嗝
example: Apart from one small hiccup, the food festival ran smoothly all weekend. (除了一個小插曲，美食節整個週末都很順利。)
Her skill at repairing clocks is famous, and her prowess surprises visitors. (她修鐘的功夫很有名，高超技藝常讓訪客驚訝。)
The chess match engrossed the old men for most of the afternoon. (這場西洋棋賽讓老人們整個下午幾乎全神貫注。)

meaning: v. 取笑；戲弄 n. 取笑者
example: His brothers always tease him about his fear of spiders, but kindly. (他哥哥們老是拿他怕蜘蛛的事取笑他，但沒有惡意。)

meaning: adj. 繁茂的；充滿活力的
example: The exuberant growth of climbing vines soon covered the whole back wall. (攀藤繁茂生長，很快覆蓋了整面後牆。)
Dolphins cavorted playfully in the warm water beside the small tour boat. (海豚在小觀光船旁溫暖的水中嬉戲。)

meaning: v. 交往；交際；使適應社會
example: The garden party gave neighbours a chance to socialise after months apart. (這場花園派對讓鄰居們在數月未見後有機會交際。)
These plants grow best at the optimum temperature of about twenty degrees. (這些植物在約二十度的最佳溫度下長得最好。)
This single molecule blocks the virus, which may clearly explain why the new drug works so surprisingly quickly. (這個單一分子能阻擋病毒，這或許清楚說明了新藥為何見效得如此快。)
Regular walking improved his fitness enough to climb the hill easily again. (規律走路讓他的體能好到能輕鬆再爬上那座山。)
She wrote a short letter regarding the noisy building work next door. (她寫了一封短函，關於隔壁吵鬧的施工。)

meaning: n. 接觸；聯絡 vt. 聯絡
example: Regular daily contact with nature clearly improves mood, yet many city children increasingly spend their entire weekends indoors. (每天規律接觸大自然明顯能改善情緒，但許多城市孩子越來越把整個週末花在室內。)

meaning: adj. 創造性的；有創意的
example: Creative writing often helps students express difficult feelings, which is why the school protects this small weekly class. (創意寫作常幫助學生表達難以言說的情緒，這就是學校保留這門小型每週課程的原因。)
The senior consultant immediately recommended surgery, but the cautious patient asked for a second opinion before finally agreeing. (資深顧問醫師立刻建議動手術，但謹慎的病人要求第二意見後才終於同意。)

meaning: adj. 次要的；中等的；輔助的
example: Cost was a secondary concern; safety came first in every single decision. (成本是次要考量；每個決定都以安全為先。)
Most residents are in favour of turning the empty lot into a park. (多數居民贊成把空地變成公園。)
Only a small fraction of the city's household rubbish is actually recycled. (這座城市的家庭垃圾只有一小部分真的被回收。)
The clerk took the manager's dictation and typed the whole letter afterwards. (職員記下經理口述的內容，之後把整封信打出來。)
Good managers engage their staff simply by listening, which often reduces turnover far more effectively than large bonuses. (優秀主管單靠傾聽就能讓員工投入，這往往比大筆獎金更有效降低流動率。)
Few families now populate the remote island, although tourists still arrive in surprisingly large numbers every hot summer. (如今很少家庭住在這座偏遠島上，但每到炎熱夏天，遊客仍以驚人的數量湧入。)

meaning: n. 銷售規劃；商品促銷
example: Good merchandising placed the bright summer hats right beside the shop entrance. (良好的商品陳列把鮮豔的夏季帽子放在店門口旁。)
She studied meteorology because she wanted to better understand storms, and now she warns fishing boats at sea. (她讀氣象學是因為想更了解暴風雨，現在她為海上的漁船發布警告。)
The local dealer repaired the water pump and supplied the missing parts. (當地經銷商修好抽水機，還提供了缺少的零件。)
The museum displays an ancient weapon made from sharp bone and stone. (博物館展示一件用銳利骨頭和石頭製成的古代武器。)
Only the head of security can authorise entry to the sealed room. (只有安全主管能授權進入那間封閉的房間。)
She carefully pored over old maps, looking for the lost village footpath. (她仔細研讀舊地圖，尋找那條消失的村間小徑。)
A spectator caught the falling child just before she hit the ground. (一名旁觀者在孩子落地前接住了她。)
He met a compatriot in the very long queue, and they spent the entire afternoon talking about home. (他在長長的人龍中遇到一位同胞，兩人整個下午都在聊家鄉。)

meaning: adj. 可怕的；令人不快的
example: A dreadful smell came from the drain outside the old kitchen window. (一股可怕的氣味從廚房舊窗外面的排水溝傳來。)
The laboratory tests confirmed that the well water was safe to drink. (實驗室檢驗證實井水可以安全飲用。)
The shuttle carried fresh supplies to the space station twice that year. (那年太空梭兩度運送補給品到太空站。)
Repairing the roof will entail moving the furniture out of the attic. (修屋頂會需要把家具搬出閣樓。)
The old alchemist kept careful detailed notes, which later clearly helped real chemists understand so many chemical reactions. (這位老鍊金術士留下仔細詳盡的筆記，後來清楚幫助真正的化學家理解那麼多化學反應。)

meaning: adj. 相反的 n. 相反
example: Contrary to the forecast, the day stayed warm, bright and completely dry. (和預報相反，那天一直溫暖晴朗又完全沒下雨。)

meaning: adj. 警惕的 n. 警報 vt. 警告
example: Despite the long and quiet shift, the night guard stayed completely alert. (儘管班很長又安靜，夜班警衛仍保持完全警惕。)

meaning: v. 移動；轉變 n. 轉變；輪班
example: The debate suddenly shifted attention to urgent housing, which had been shamefully ignored by both major parties for years. (這場辯論突然把焦點轉向迫切的住房問題，而兩大黨多年來都可恥地忽視它。)
The mere sight of the open sea made the tired travellers smile. (光是看到開闊的大海，就讓疲憊的旅人笑了。)

meaning: n. 監視器；班長 vt. 監視；監測
example: A small monitor above the door shows the temperature inside the greenhouse. (門上方的小監視器顯示溫室內的溫度。)
She derives great pleasure from daily gardening, which keeps her active and calm after a very long week. (她從每天園藝中獲得極大樂趣，這讓她在漫長一週後仍保持活躍與平靜。)

meaning: n. 願望；慾望 v. 渴望；期望
example: His desire for constant approval made him simply agree to everything, which close colleagues eventually found rather exhausting. (他渴望不斷獲得認同，讓他凡事都乾脆同意，親近同事最後覺得相當累人。)

meaning: adj. 最小的；最低限度的
example: The repair caused minimal damage to the garden and the old fence. (這次修繕對花園和舊圍欄造成的損害很小。)

meaning: n. 素描；草圖 v. 素描；概述
example: He made a quick sketch of the harbour before the light faded. (他在光線消失前迅速畫了一張港口的素描。)

meaning: v. 落後；走得慢 n. 落後；時間差
example: Some regions still lag behind in fast broadband, which makes daily remote work difficult for many rural residents. (有些地區在高速寬頻上仍落後，這讓許多鄉村居民難以每天遠距工作。)

meaning: vt. 引發；觸發 n. 扳機
example: Pollen can trigger a serious sudden allergy, so sufferers should carefully check the daily forecast before going outside. (花粉可能引發嚴重的突發過敏，因此患者出門前應仔細查看每日預報。)

meaning: n. 補充物；增刊 vt. 補充
example: He takes a daily iron supplement because his diet lacks red meat. (他每天吃鐵質補充劑，因為他的飲食缺少紅肉。)
The joke was meant to amuse, but it did offend several guests. (那個笑話本意是逗人開心，卻冒犯了好幾位客人。)
She described a strange vivid dream, in which she walked through a forest full of brightly coloured birds. (她描述了一個奇特鮮明的夢，夢裡她走過一座滿是鮮豔鳥類的森林。)
As for the broken window, the landlord has promised to fix it. (至於那扇破窗，房東已承諾會修好。)
A low white hedge encloses the neat garden behind the old cottage. (一道低矮的白籬圍住老屋後方整潔的花園。)
The nurse adjusted the dose for small children, carefully checking the child's weight before measuring the exact liquid. (護理師調整兒童的劑量，量取確切藥液前仔細核對孩子的體重。)

meaning: n. 供給；補給品 vt. 供應；滿足
example: The supply chain suddenly broke down, so local shops ran out of essential basic goods within two days. (供應鏈突然中斷，當地商店兩天內就賣光基本必需品。)
A change in the weather is on the horizon, according to the fishers. (漁民說天氣即將出現變化。)

meaning: v. 壓縮；壓緊 n. 敷布
example: Farmers compress hay into tight square blocks to store it for winter. (農民把乾草壓成緊實的方塊，儲存起來過冬。)

meaning: n. 興趣；利息；利益 vt. 使感興趣
example: Rising interest rates hit very young families hardest, since most of their income already goes on monthly rent. (利率上升對非常年輕的家庭打擊最大，因為他們大部分收入已花在每月房租上。)
The team overcame several serious obstacles, including a broken old pump and two days of continuous heavy rain. (團隊克服了幾項嚴重障礙，包括一台故障的舊抽水機和連續兩天的大雨。)
Her academic achievement improved after she joined a small study group, although she still finds maths rather difficult. (她加入小型讀書會後學業成績進步了，儘管她仍覺得數學相當難。)
Bats leave their hiding places at dusk and hunt over the pond. (蝙蝠在黃昏離開藏身處，在池塘上方覓食。)
The small shop quietly ceased trading in March, and the old building has remained completely empty ever since. (這家小店三月悄悄停止營業，那棟老建築從此完全空置。)

meaning: adj. 可耕作的 n. 耕地
example: Local arable farming depends on healthy soil, yet intensive methods often remove nutrients faster than nature replaces them. (當地耕作依賴健康的土壤，但密集農法移除養分的速度往往快於自然補充。)
The airport becomes completely congested every busy Friday, when hundreds of weekend flights depart within two short hours. (每逢繁忙的週五，機場就變得完全擁擠，數百架週末航班在短短兩小時內起飛。)

meaning: v. 分裂；撕裂；分擔 n. 裂口；分裂
example: The group split into two teams to search both sides of the valley. (隊伍分成兩組，搜索山谷兩側。)
There is a distinct difference between the two proposals on housing policy. (這兩項住宅政策提案有明顯的差異。)

meaning: v. 協商；談判；順利通過
example: Union leaders will negotiate with management over pay and working hours next week. (工會領袖下週將與資方協商薪資和工時。)
It is cruel to mock a child's stutter, since the damage to their confidence can last for many years. (嘲笑孩子的口吃很殘忍，因為對自信造成的傷害可能持續許多年。)
Nordic countries are often praised for their generous parental leave and public childcare. (北歐國家常因優渥的育嬰假和公共托育而受到讚揚。)

meaning: vi. 逗留；流連；緩慢消失
example: The memory of that quiet afternoon lingered for years, although the place itself has changed completely beyond recognition. (那個安靜午後的記憶留存了好些年，儘管那地方本身已徹底改變，面目全非。)
The scan results showed the womb was clearly healthy, so the young couple finally began to deeply relax. (掃描結果顯示子宮明顯健康，這對年輕夫妻終於深深鬆了一口氣。)
Living near a railway station is advantageous for people who commute to the city. (住在火車站附近，對通勤到市區的人很有利。)

meaning: n. 策略；移動 v. 操縱；移動
example: The company's latest manoeuvre was designed to avoid paying significantly higher taxes. (公司最新的策略是為了避免繳納更高的稅。)
Predatory lending practices have left many low-income families trapped in serious debt. (掠奪性貸款讓許多低收入家庭陷入債務。)

meaning: vi. 談話 n. 相反的事物 adj. 相反的
example: We conversed quietly in the garden while the children played nearby on the grass. (我們在花園裡輕聲交談，孩子們在旁邊玩耍。)

My adventurous cousin spent a year hiking through remote mountains in South America. (我愛冒險的表哥花了一年在南美洲的偏遠山區健行。)
The report criticised factories that rely on exploitative labour to keep prices low. (報告批評那些靠剝削勞工來壓低價格的工廠。)

The village sits on a high plateau where temperatures drop sharply at night. (這座村莊位於高原地帶，夜間氣溫驟降。)

Layers of volcanic ash overlie the ancient settlement, making careful excavation difficult. (層層火山灰覆蓋著古代聚落，使挖掘工作十分困難。)

meaning: adj. 可預測的；墨守成規的
example: His daily routine is so predictable that his colleagues can guess what he will order. (他的日常作息一成不變，同事都能猜到他要點什麼。)
Geological surveys suggest that the area could experience a serious earthquake soon. (地質調查顯示，這個地區可能發生嚴重地震。)
The new rail link should quickly halve the long journey time, making daily morning commuting far more attractive. (新鐵路連結應能迅速把漫長的通勤時間減半，讓每天早晨通勤變得更有吸引力。)
Children assimilate new languages more quickly when they hear them every day. (孩子在每天聽到新語言時，吸收得更快。)

meaning: n. 港灣 v. 停泊；隱匿
example: Fishing boats returned to the harbour before the storm reached the coast. (漁船在暴風雨抵達海岸前返回港灣。)

meaning: n. 雜種；混血兒；混合物 adj. 混合的
example: A quiet hybrid car uses less fuel in town, but it still needs petrol on long motorway trips. (安靜的油電混合車在市區較省油，但在高速公路長途行駛仍需要汽油。)
People who inhale wood smoke regularly seriously damage their lungs, even when the daily exposure seems comparatively small. (經常吸入木柴煙的人會嚴重損害肺部，即使每日暴露量看起來相對不大。)
A normal whisper is usually about thirty decibels, which is why public libraries feel so deeply calm and restful. (正常耳語通常約三十分貝，這就是公共圖書館讓人感到深深平靜與安寧的原因。)

meaning: n. 航行；旅行 v. 航行
example: The voyage across the Pacific took nearly three weeks in calm weather. (這趟橫越太平洋的航行在風平浪靜的天氣下花了將近三週。)
The cherry blossom lasts only a brief week, so crowds suddenly rush to the nearby park every spring. (櫻花只盛開短短一週，因此每年春天人群都會突然湧向附近的公園。)
Every school needs a clear contingency plan for sudden power cuts, especially during the long cold winter months. (每所學校都需要明確的突發停電應變計畫，尤其是在漫長寒冷的冬季。)
She moved to a quieter town for the sake of her health. (為了健康，她搬到一個更安靜的小鎮。)
A warm bath can relieve muscle pain after a long day of walking. (走了一整天後，泡個熱水澡可以緩解肌肉痠痛。)
The council's stance on the new bypass has suddenly changed, which has clearly disappointed many angry local campaigners. (市公所對新外環道的立場突然改變，這明顯讓許多憤怒的當地倡議者失望。)

meaning: n. 行為；管理 v. 實施；指揮
example: The doctor's professional conduct was seriously questioned after several patients openly complained about rude remarks during brief consultations. (幾位病人公開抱怨短暫看診期間的無禮言語後，這名醫師的專業行為受到嚴重質疑。)

meaning: n. 配偶；夥伴 v. 交配
example: An old mate at work lent me his small van, which saved me the whole cost of hiring one. (一位工作上的老夥伴把他的小廂型車借我，省下了我租車的全部費用。)

meaning: n./v. 攻擊；抨擊；（疾病）發作
example: The report is a fierce attack on the policy, arguing that it wasted a great deal of public money. (這份報告對該政策提出猛烈抨擊，主張它浪費了大量公帑。)

meaning: vt. 使喪失信譽；使懷疑
example: The company tried to discredit the small rival study, but independent experts clearly refused to accept its claims. (公司試圖貶損那份小型競爭研究，但獨立專家明確拒絕接受它的說法。)
The city's flora has changed dramatically as many imported garden plants have slowly spread into the surrounding woods. (這座城市的植物群已大幅改變，許多進口園藝植物慢慢蔓延到周遭林地。)

meaning: n. 團；群眾；質量 adj. 大量的 v. 聚集

Shops anticipate a serious shortage of batteries, so they have already ordered large extra stock before the cold winter. (商店預期電池會嚴重短缺，因此在寒冬前已訂購大量額外存貨。)

meaning: v. 操作；運轉；動手術；經營
example: The plant operates around the clock to meet demand for bottled water. (這座工廠全天候運轉，以滿足瓶裝水的需求。)

meaning: n. 旁道 vt. 繞過

A narrow shaft of light entered the old cellar, revealing boxes that had been completely forgotten for decades. (一道窄窄的光束射進老地窖，照出幾箱被完全遺忘數十年的箱子。)
The embassy opened a clear direct channel, which helped many families find missing relatives after the powerful earthquake. (大使館開闢了清楚的直接管道，協助許多家庭在強震後找到失蹤親人。)
The committee will carefully determine eligibility for the grant, using official income records and proof of local residence. (委員會將仔細判定補助資格，依據官方收入紀錄和本地居住證明。)
A handful of large firms dominate the market for household cleaning products. (少數幾家大公司支配了家用清潔用品市場。)
She was instrumental in persuading the council to fund the new library. (她在說服市議會資助新圖書館一事上發揮了關鍵作用。)

meaning: v. 裝載 n. 負荷；大量

The new manager improved customer service within a few months, although staff still constantly complain about low pay. (新經理幾個月內改善了客服品質，但員工仍不斷抱怨薪資太低。)

meaning: adj. 敏感的；靈敏的；易受傷害的
example: Race remains a very sensitive topic, so teachers prepare carefully before openly discussing it with the whole class. (種族仍是個非常敏感的話題，因此教師在與全班公開討論前都仔細準備。)
Campaigners want the government to abolish all application fees for university places. (倡議人士希望政府廢除大學入學申請費。)
Her conception of success has changed since she started working with refugees. (自從她開始與難民共事後，她對成功的概念改變了。)

meaning: vt. 遭遇；偶遇 n. 遭遇

meaning: n. 泡；氣泡 vi. 冒泡
example: A single bubble rose slowly to the surface of the quiet pond. (一顆氣泡緩緩升上池塘水面。)

meaning: n. 樣品；樣本 vt. 取樣；品嚐

His leg was covered in plaster for six weeks after the accident. (意外發生後，他的腿打了六週石膏。)
The restaurant occupies the top storey of a converted warehouse near the river. (這家餐廳位於河邊一棟改建倉庫的頂樓。)

meaning: n. 一幫；一夥 v. 結夥

The social enterprise trains unemployed local adults, selling repaired old bicycles to fund its free practical training courses. (這家社會企業訓練失業的當地成人，販售修理好的舊腳踏車來資助免費實作課程。)
Officials could not immediately verify the original document, so the whole application was quietly put on official hold. (官員無法立即核實原始文件，因此整份申請被悄悄正式擱置。)

meaning: n. 線；弦；一串 vt. 串起；縛
example: She kept a string of receipts in a drawer beside the kitchen door. (她把一串收據放在廚房門邊的抽屜裡。)

meaning: n. 垃圾；一窩幼崽 v. 亂扔

The film crew chose a coastal location because it offered dramatic light. (劇組選擇海岸地點，因為那裡的光線很有戲劇張力。)
A breakdown in the cooling system forced the factory to stop production. (冷卻系統故障迫使工廠停止生產。)

meaning: adj. 無法抗拒的；極誘人的

meaning: n. 線人；提供資料的人

meaning: adj. 生成的；有生產力的

meaning: adj. 嚴謹的；一絲不苟的

The emeritus professor still visits the department regularly to supervise postgraduate students. (這位榮譽退休教授仍會到系上指導研究生。)

meaning: adj. 可預見的；可預測的

Protesters hurled stones at the police as the march reached the square. (遊行隊伍抵達廣場時，抗議者向警方猛丟石塊。)

meaning: vt. 複製；重複 n. 複製品 adj. 完全相同的
example: Please duplicate the key so that each tenant has their own copy. (請複製這把鑰匙，讓每位房客都有自己的副本。)

meaning: n. 蘑菇 vi. 迅速發展
example: Online delivery services mushroomed during the years when many people worked from home. (在許多人居家工作的那幾年，線上外送服務迅速發展。)
The film is an adaptation of a novel set during the industrial revolution. (這部電影改編自一本以工業革命為背景的小說。)

meaning: n. 菁英；中堅 adj. 精銳的
example: Young elite athletes often train daily, yet many still earn surprisingly much less than ordinary full-time office workers. (年輕菁英運動員常每天訓練，但許多人收入仍遠低於普通全職上班族，令人意外。)
Keep your contact details up-to-date so the clinic can reach you quickly. (請保持聯絡資料最新，以便診所快速聯絡到你。)
Workers buried the old power lines underground, which greatly improved the appearance of the whole quiet residential street. (工人把舊電線埋入地下，大大改善了整條安靜住宅街的外觀。)

meaning: adj. 適度的；溫和的 v. 緩和；使適中
example: Moderate exercise three times a week can significantly lower your blood pressure. (每週三次適度運動可以顯著降低血壓。)

meaning: adj. 大膽的；粗體的；醒目的

meaning: n. 獎；獎品 vt. 授予
example: He received a local award for bravery, although he modestly insists he simply did what anyone would have done. (他獲得當地英勇獎，儘管他謙虛地堅稱自己只是做了任何人都會做的事。)

The clinic offers free support to people who are addicted to gambling. (這家診所為賭博成癮者提供支持。)

The museum reproduced the famous painting digitally, allowing local schools to print cheap copies for detailed classroom discussion. (博物館以數位方式複製這幅名畫，讓當地學校能印製便宜副本供課堂詳細討論。)

meaning: n. 路標 vt. 設路標
example: The old signpost was completely missing, so we finally relied on a helpful farmer's rather vague directions instead. (老路標完全不見了，所以我們最後改靠一位好心農夫相當模糊的指路。)

meaning: n. 意圖；目的 adj. 專注的
example: The letter was clearly written with the intent to mislead foreign investors. (這封信顯然是意圖誤導投資人。)

meaning: n. 人工製品；手工藝品
example: A local farmer found the ancient artefact by accident, and archaeologists later carefully confirmed its surprising great age. (一位當地農夫意外發現這件古代文物，考古學家後來仔細確認它驚人的年代。)
Sheep and cattle graze freely on the highlands throughout the summer months. (牛羊整個夏季都在高地上吃草。)
Her job application was very strong, yet the panel finally chose someone with considerably more relevant practical experience. (她的求職申請很出色，但評審最後選了具備更多相關實務經驗的人。)

meaning: n. 挑戰；難題 vt. 挑戰；質疑
example: The winter climb is a genuinely serious physical challenge, so always prepare carefully and never go completely alone. (冬季攀登是真正嚴峻的體能挑戰，因此一定要仔細準備，且絕不要完全獨自前往。)

Summer in the southern hemisphere falls between December and the end of February. (南半球的夏季落在十二月到二月底之間。)

meaning: adj. 公民的；民用的；國內的
example: Civil society groups played a key role in shaping the new law. (公民社會團體在形塑這項新法律上扮演關鍵角色。)

A gigantic crane slowly lifted the damaged containers off the cargo ship. (一台巨大的起重機慢慢把受損的貨櫃吊離貨船。)
The organisers changed the venue because the original hall was too small. (主辦單位更換場地，因為原本的廳太小。)
She grieved for months after her closest friend moved abroad without saying goodbye. (她最親近的朋友不告而別搬到國外後，她悲傷了好幾個月。)
The artist converted a garage into a studio where she could paint. (這位藝術家把車庫改成可以作畫的工作室。)
The remote island has fewer than three hundred permanent inhabitants, mostly fishermen. (這座偏遠島嶼的常住居民不到三百人，大多是漁民。)

meaning: adj. 自殺的；有自殺傾向的
example: The leaflet explains where to get help if someone has suicidal thoughts, and stresses that recovery is possible. (這份傳單說明有人出現自殺念頭時可去哪裡求助，並強調康復是可能的。)
The two countries held annual bilateral talks, hoping to finally settle the trade dispute before the new year. (兩國舉行年度雙邊會談，希望在過年前終於解決貿易爭端。)
A free clinic opens every Saturday for local residents without health insurance. (每週六開設免費診所，服務沒有健康保險的居民。)

meaning: adj. 難忘的；容易記住的
example: Her performance was surprisingly memorable for its quiet honesty, even though she forgot several lines near the end. (她的演出因為安靜的誠懇而意外令人難忘，儘管她在接近尾聲時忘了幾句台詞。)

meaning: v. 使目眩；使傾倒 n. 耀眼
example: The low sun dazzled drivers on the motorway during the evening rush. (傍晚尖峰時段，低垂的太陽讓高速公路上的駕駛目眩。)
There is clearly a vast difference between the two local regions, in both their climate and average income. (這兩個鄰近地區之間明顯有巨大差異，無論氣候或平均收入都不同。)

meaning: adj. 地下的 n. 地鐵 adv. 在地下
example: The hidden underground river slowly flows beneath the whole city, finally emerging near the old stone harbour bridge. (這條隱藏的地下河緩緩流過整座城市下方，最後在老石造港橋附近冒出地面。)
The young scholar argued that the letters were clearly forged, based on careful detailed analysis of the paper. (這位年輕學者主張這些信件明顯是偽造的，依據是對紙張的仔細詳盡分析。)
Thousands of students compete nationally for a few university places, so the written entrance test is extremely demanding. (數千名學生在全國競爭少數大學名額，因此筆試入學考極其嚴苛。)
The doctor wrote a prescription for painkillers and told him to rest. (醫生開了一張止痛藥處方，並叫他休息。)

meaning: adj. 天然的；粗糙的；粗俗的
example: Crude oil prices rose sharply after the pipeline was damaged by flooding. (管線因洪水受損後，原油價格大幅上漲。)

meaning: v. 變化；不同；使多樣化
example: Ticket prices vary depending on the day of the week and the season. (票價依星期幾和季節而有所不同。)
The committee is composed of teachers, parents and several local business owners. (委員會由教師、家長和當地企業主組成。)
We waited in vain for the last bus, and eventually simply walked the whole long way home in the dark. (我們徒然等最後一班公車，最後乾脆在黑暗中走了整段長路回家。)
A group of cats lives in the narrow alley, fed quietly by the local restaurant staff each evening. (一群貓住在窄巷裡，每晚由當地餐廳員工悄悄餵食。)
A dolphin swam alongside the small boat for several minutes before disappearing. (一隻海豚在船邊游了幾分鐘才消失。)

meaning: v. 彈起；反彈 n. 彈跳；活力
example: The ball bounced off the wall and landed in the neighbour's garden. (球從牆上彈開，落在鄰居的花園裡。)
We waited on platform four for a train that was already late. (我們在第四月臺等一班已經誤點的火車。)
The atmosphere in the small room was clearly tense, although everyone still tried to speak politely to each other. (小房間裡的氣氛明顯緊張，儘管大家仍試著彼此禮貌交談。)
The board appointed her as chief executive after a long global search. (董事會在長時間尋覓後任命她為執行長。)

meaning: n. 特性；特徵 adj. 典型的
example: A long tail is a useful characteristic of this species, clearly helping it balance in very high branches. (長尾巴是這個物種的有用特徵，明顯幫助牠在很高的樹枝上保持平衡。)
Careful forensic tests identified the victim within just a few days, which finally gave the grieving family some much-needed answers. (仔細的法醫檢驗在短短幾天內確認了死者身分，終於給悲痛的家屬一些亟需的答案。)
At this altitude, water boils at a much lower temperature than at sea level. (在這個海拔，水的沸點比海平面低得多。)
Few candidates possess both the technical knowledge and the communication skills required. (很少有應徵者同時具備所需的技術知識和溝通能力。)

meaning: n. 興奮；令人興奮的事
example: The children's real excitement was clearly obvious, although the first promised snow had still not arrived by lunchtime. (孩子們真正的興奮明顯可見，儘管第一場預告的雪到午餐時間仍未落下。)
There is a clear contradiction between the company's green claims and its actions. (公司的環保說法和實際行動之間有明顯矛盾。)

meaning: adj. 煞費苦心的；勤勉的
example: Restoring the damaged painting was painstaking work that took nearly four years. (修復這幅畫是件煞費苦心的苦工，花了將近四年。)
She gave up a stable job in pursuit of a career in photography. (她放棄穩定工作，追求攝影師的職涯。)

meaning: adj. 人文主義的；人性的
example: The school's humanistic approach emphasises creativity and cooperation rather than endless testing. (這所學校的人文主義方針強調創造力與合作，而非無止境的考試。)
The report lacks a coherent argument and repeatedly makes the same points. (這份報告缺乏連貫的論點，還重複同樣的觀點。)
Her outlook on work changed after she spent a year volunteering abroad. (在國外志工服務一年後，她對工作的看法改變了。)
The committee must decide how to apportion the limited funds among the projects. (委員會必須決定如何在各項計畫間分配有限經費。)
Awareness of our own finitude can make people value time more deeply. (意識到自身生命的有限，可以讓人更深刻地珍惜時間。)

meaning: adj. 可耗盡的；會枯竭的
example: Fossil fuels are exhaustible, which is why investment in renewable energy is essential. (化石燃料會枯竭，因此投資再生能源至關重要。)
The revelation that the factory dumped waste into the river caused public anger. (工廠把廢棄物倒進河裡的真相曝光後，引發民眾憤怒。)
The plan met strong resistance from residents who feared losing their parking spaces. (這項計畫遭到居民強烈反對，他們擔心失去停車位。)

meaning: adj. 可達到的；可實現的
example: The government's housing target looks attainable only if construction speeds up sharply. (政府的住宅目標只有在建設加速時才看似可達成。)

meaning: adj. 必不可少的；必需的
example: Clean water is indispensable for public health, yet millions still lack it. (乾淨的水對公共衛生必不可少，但數百萬人仍缺乏。)
The coastal region is famous for its spicy cuisine and exceptionally fresh seafood. (這個沿海地區以辛辣菜餚和格外新鮮的海鮮聞名。)

meaning: adj. 名聲好的；值得信賴的
example: Always book through a reputable travel agency before paying a large deposit. (支付大筆訂金前，一定要透過信譽良好的旅行社訂位。)

meaning: vt. 使黯然失色；給……蒙上陰影
example: The success of the opening ceremony was overshadowed by a serious security failure. (開幕典禮的成功，因嚴重的安全疏失而黯然失色。)
The city offers unparalleled opportunities for young people starting careers in finance. (這座城市為投入金融業的年輕人提供無比的機會。)
The hotel's opulence contrasts sharply with the poverty of the surrounding neighbourhood. (飯店的富麗與周圍社區的貧困形成強烈對比。)
Digital tickets will gradually supersede paper ones on most regional railway routes. (在大多數區域鐵路路線，電子票將逐漸取代紙本票。)
The rapid exploitation of mineral resources has damaged rivers and farmland nearby. (礦產資源的快速開發已損害附近的河流和農地。)

meaning: adj. 充滿熱情的；熱切的
example: She is passionate about reducing food waste in large restaurants and hotels. (她熱衷於減少餐廳和飯店的糧食浪費。)
The old factory released a poisonous gas, forcing hundreds of nearby residents to stay indoors for two days. (老工廠外洩有毒氣體，迫使附近數百名居民待在室內兩天。)

meaning: v. 剝去；剝奪 n. 條；帶
example: Workers stripped the old wallpaper from the bedroom walls before repainting them. (工人先剝除臥室牆上的舊壁紙，再重新粉刷。)

meaning: v. 使疲憊；耗盡 n. 廢氣
example: The long journey quickly exhausted our small food supply, so we finally stopped at the next quiet village. (長途旅程很快耗盡我們不多的食物，所以我們最後在下一個安靜村莊停下。)

meaning: adj. 神秘的；不可思議的
example: A strange mysterious light suddenly appeared above the calm lake, and no one in the village could properly explain it. (一道奇異神祕的光突然出現在平靜湖面上方，村裡沒有人能好好解釋。)
He left the job out of spite after being passed over for promotion. (他因為升遷被跳過，出於惡意辭職。)
Losing a passport abroad is very stressful, so always keep a clear photocopy in a small separate bag. (在國外遺失護照壓力很大，因此一定要把清楚的影本放在另一個小袋子裡。)
Traffic was diverted through quiet residential streets while the bridge was repaired. (橋樑維修期間，車流被改道到安靜的住宅街道。)
The rapid dissemination of research often helps doctors, yet it also spreads unfinished findings before checks are complete. (研究快速散布往往有助醫師，但也會在審查完成前傳播尚未定論的發現。)

meaning: adj. 永久的；連續不斷的
example: The village lives under the perpetual threat of landslides during the rainy season. (雨季期間，這個村莊一直處於山崩的永久威脅之下。)
The witness contradicted her earlier statement when the police showed her the photographs. (警方出示照片時，證人推翻了自己先前的說法。)
Neighbours organized a street party to welcome the families who had recently arrived. (鄰居籌辦了一場街頭派對，歡迎最近搬來的家庭。)
He writes a weekly column about food and farming for a national newspaper. (他為一家全國性報紙撰寫每週的美食與農業專欄。)
The river is an important source of drinking water for nearby towns. (這條河是附近城鎮重要的飲用水來源。)
The hotel caters mainly for business travellers who need fast internet access. (這家飯店主要迎合需要快速網路的商務旅客。)

meaning: n. 大廳；遊說團 v. 遊說
example: The farming lobby has resisted tighter limits on the use of pesticides. (農業遊說團抵制了更嚴格的農藥使用限制。)
Flexible working hours allow many parents to collect their children from school. (彈性工時讓許多家長能到學校接孩子。)
Companies that pollute rivers now face a heavy financial penalty under the new law. (根據新法，汙染河川的公司現在面臨鉅額罰款。)
Landlords must comply with basic safety rules or risk losing their licence. (房東必須遵守安全規定，否則可能失去執照。)
He bought a new tennis racket before joining the local tennis club. (他在加入當地俱樂部前買了一支新網球拍。)
A dangerous loose wire caused the machine to suddenly stop, so the whole workshop closed for safety inspections. (一條危險的鬆脫電線讓機器突然停止，因此整個工坊關閉進行安全檢查。)
Take one capsule with water after breakfast, as directed on the label. (依照標籤指示，早餐後配水服用一顆膠囊。)
The staff canteen serves cheap meals, but the queue is always long. (員工餐廳供應便宜餐點，但排隊人潮總是很多。)
Modern aeronautics research has significantly improved fuel efficiency, which matters greatly as airlines try to cut carbon emissions. (現代航空學研究大幅提升了燃油效率，這在航空公司努力減碳時格外重要。)
They finally adopted a young child from abroad, a difficult long process that took almost three full years. (他們終於從國外收養了一名幼童，這段艱難漫長的過程花了將近整整三年。)

meaning: n. 租約 vt. 出租；租用
example: They signed a two-year lease on the flat before rents rose sharply. (他們在房價上漲前簽了兩年租約。)
A good bit of luck helped us finally find the house, since the address was clearly slightly wrong. (一點好運幫我們終於找到那棟房子，因為地址明顯有點錯誤。)
The company concealed evidence that its product could overheat in hot weather. (公司隱瞞了產品在高溫下可能過熱的證據。)

meaning: n. 妥協；折中辦法 v. 妥協；危及
example: After hours of talks, both sides reached a compromise on working hours. (經過數小時會談，雙方就工時達成妥協。)
Their haphazard approach to planning clearly caused many delays, although the final result turned out to be surprisingly good. (他們毫無計畫的規劃方式明顯造成許多延誤，不過最後結果卻出乎意料地好。)

meaning: adj. 必要的；本質的 n. 要素；要點
example: Good lighting is essential for anyone who works at a computer all day. (良好的照明對整天用電腦工作的人不可或缺。)

meaning: v. 敦促；力勸；竭力主張
example: Doctors urged the government to invest more money in local mental health services. (醫生敦促政府增加對地方心理衛生服務的投資。)
Building a tram line through the city centre may not be financially feasible. (在市中心興建有軌電車路線，財務上可能不可行。)

meaning: n. 穀類植物；穀物；穀類食品
example: He eats cereal with fresh fruit for breakfast before cycling to work. (他早餐吃穀片配新鮮水果，然後騎腳踏車上班。)
